kyoto_rung_arun_thai.gf_detail: Ask. Thai rice and rice-noodle dishes, but also fried spring rolls, egg noodles, fish-sauce and soy-based sauces; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use fish sauce, shrimp, pork or chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.hours_raw: Tuesday to Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; bookings lapse 30 minutes after the time without contact; two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). 23 seats: 5 at the counter, 18 at tables; private hire 20–50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). English menu with photos; takeaway (Tabelog). Third floor of 遊里香ビル on Kiyamachi above Sanjo, above a ramen shop; 3 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 2 June 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rung_arun_thai.notes: [Thai · Kiyamachi above Sanjo, lunch sets upstairs] A third-floor Thai room on Kiyamachi, opened in 2025, easy to miss above a ramen shop. Lunch sets of about ¥1,100–1,500 bring salad, soup, shrimp chips and a mini dessert with khao man gai, pad thai, green curry or tom yum noodles; staff will steer you to milder dishes. Dinner adds tom yum hot pot and seafood curry with Thai beer. English menu. Busy at lunch — book. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 2 June 2025, serving authentic Thai dishes in a wood-toned room for up to 23. Reviewers in 2026 describe friendly staff, kitchen staff who laughed along with a guest practising Thai, and a busy lunch trade.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets; pad thai; tom yum.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular asked the kitchen to teach the Thai phrase for a dish, mispronounced it into an unintended joke, and the whole room laughed — "something Thai people cherish."
"I asked the staff for recommendations on milder dishes, and I ended up having a delicious meal." — May 2026.
"It seems to be a popular spot; I was able to get in early in the evening, but it looked like later customers would have a hard time without a reservation." — May 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: タイ料理・東南アジア料理・エスニック、中京区上大阪町528 遊里香ビル3F、京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日・祝 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、月曜休み、予約可 (30分連絡なしで取消、混雑時2時間制)、23席 (カウンター5、テーブル18)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、Wi-Fi、カード・PayPay 可、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、ベジタリアン対応あり、2025年6月2日オープン、トムヤムクン鍋、ガパオ、シーフードカレー、タイビール。口コミ (2026年5月〜11月、英語): ランチセット (サラダ、スープ、えびせん、ミニデザート)、カオマンガイ1,100円、パッタイ、グリーンカレー、トムヤムラーメン、ポーピアトート、ラートナー1,210円、スップノーマイ1,100円、昼は混む。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos (Tabelog); ask staff for milder dishes; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya dishes including edamame tempura, a rare salmon cutlet, sushi rolls, hot pots and cheesecake; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood-focused izakaya of sashimi, seafood rolls, katsuo tataki, salmon and fish hot pots (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday to Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday 15:00–23:00; Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted by phone; DMs are not answered during opening hours (Tabelog); 19:00 slots fill, with 90-minute seatings at busy times (March 2026). No table charge (Tabelog original チャージ料無し). Orders by smartphone (July 2026). 16 seats: 6 at a ground-floor counter, 10 at tables upstairs; private hire up to 20; non-smoking, smoking area outside (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay (Tabelog). In the 三条食彩ろぉじ alley of small shops — look for the red noren (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_ofuro_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Sanjo food alley, seafood rolls and edamame tempura] A small, young izakaya behind a red noren in a lane of tiny shops off Sanjo: sushi rolls heaped with seafood, edamame tempura, rare salmon cutlet, katsuo tataki and fish hot pots in winter, with fruit sours and sake. Staff are friendly and chatty, and both regulars and travellers fill it — book, as evening slots go fast. One August 2026 guest found the counter noisy. Orders go through your smartphone. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a young team cooking dish by dish in a small kitchen, friendly service and drink suggestions, many regulars, and a sister restaurant, SAUNA (April and August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seafood-overflow rolls; edamame tempura.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor stayed longer than planned, and on the way out one of the staff flashed a peace sign.
"The Edamame Tempura, a popular menu item, was especially tasty and disappeared quickly!" — March 2026.
"I had my meal at the counter, but it was quite noisy, possibly because there were many regular customers." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区道祐町135-1 三条食彩ろぉじ、月・水〜金 17:00〜23:00、土 15:00〜23:00、日 15:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可 (営業中はDMに返信できない)、チャージ料無し、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル10)、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)、カード・PayPay 可。口コミ (2026年1月〜8月、英語): 若いスタッフ、姉妹店 SAUNA、海鮮こぼれ巻き、明太子巻き、鰹のたたき、いかのお造り、枝豆の天ぷら、サーモンのレアカツ、クリームチーズのディップ、鱧と松茸の天ぷら、冬は白子、ぶり鍋、日替わりのチーズケーキ、あまおうのサワー、スマホで注文、1階カウンター・2階テーブル、常連が多く騒がしいとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering; book by phone; no table charge; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase kappo courses with dashi, soy-based sauces, saba sushi, ganmodoki and fried ginkgo; no gluten information (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses of Setouchi fish, hamo, anago, sweetfish and duck liver, on dashi (official site; 2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday 18:30–23:30, last order 20:30; closed Wednesday (official site). Tabelog gives 18:00–24:00 with last seating 22:00, and lunch by reservation only; lunch serves the same courses as dinner (2025 review). Reservations through the official site (AutoReserve) or by phone (official site; Tabelog); book well ahead — locals fill it (June 2025). A fixed course of about ¥14,000–15,000 (2022–2024 reviews); reviewers spent ¥15,000–29,999 (2025–2026). 10 seats: 6 at the counter and one table of 4; non-smoking (Tabelog; February 2024). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (official site; Tabelog). Near the corner of the Daikokuya supermarket, Kitashirakawa, by Kyoto University; 3 min walk from the Ginkakuji-michi bus stop (Tabelog; May 2022).
kyoto_nakazen_kitashirakawa.notes: [Kappo · Kitashirakawa, a couple since 2009] A ten-seat kappo near Ginkakuji-michi, opened in 2009 by a husband and wife: the chef (trained at Kikunoi, reviewers say) cooks Setouchi fish and Ohara vegetables into a fixed omakase of around ¥15,000, and the okami, a sake sommelier per one reviewer, pairs local sake or wine. Generous, unfussy and warm, with leftover rice wrapped as onigiri. Popular with locals — book well ahead. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Okami (the wife of the owner, unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in Kitashirakawa in 2009 and run by a married couple; the owner honed skills at famous Kyoto restaurants and wanted a kappo that is easier and freer to enjoy; fish from the Seto Inland Sea and vegetables from Ohara. Reviewers say the owner seems to have trained at Kikunoi (October 2022) and that the chef trained at Kikunoi and the okami is a sake sommelier (February 2026). A September 2025 reviewer calls it a Michelin one-star restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: "A kappo to enjoy more closely and more freely" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase course; hamo; saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 guest on a fourth visit, coming only every year or two, was still remembered.
February and September, the low seasons in Kyoto, are a "special service month with more extravagant dishes" (February 2024).
A June 2025 guest who could not get a booking on an earlier trip — locals had taken every seat — called the hamo, cut with a large steel knife, the best of a lifetime.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・北白川の夫婦で営む隠れ家的な割烹、2009年開店、京都の名店で腕を磨いた店主、女将の気配り、瀬戸内の魚介と大原の野菜、地酒とイタリア・フランスのワイン、ペアリング、月・火・木〜日 18:30〜23:30 (L.O.20:30)、水曜休み、最寄りは元田中駅、駐車場なし、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、予約は公式サイトから。食べログ: 日本料理、左京区北白川久保田町26、銀閣寺道バス停から徒歩3分、10席 (カウンター6、テーブル4)、昼は予約のみ。口コミ (2022年5月〜2026年2月、英語): Kikunoi で修業したという店主、女将は sake sommelier、おまかせ14,000円ほど、2月と9月は特別に豪華、鱧、伝助穴子、ぐじのお椀、八寸、鯖寿司、ご飯の残りはおにぎりに、ミシュラン一つ星との記述 (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online through the official site (multilingual) well ahead; fixed omakase; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

kyoto_synager.gf_detail: Ask. A French tasting course with sauces, terrines, fried amuse-bouches, bread, butter and baked sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a set French course of fish, shellfish, foie gras and meat, with butter and cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–15:00 (last food order 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 19:00); closed Monday, open on holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). Courses with wine or non-alcoholic aroma pairings: lunch with four pairings a little over ¥12,000 (September 2026); bills ¥10,000–29,999 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). 12 seats; private hire for 6 or more, children welcome when booked whole (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). A renovated machiya down a cobbled alley through a small wooden gate, Higashinotoin north of Nijo; 4 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (subway) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_synager.notes: [French · Higashinotoin Nijo, aromas and non-alcoholic pairings] A twelve-seat French restaurant in a renovated machiya down a cobbled alley near the Imperial Palace, where a chef who is also an herb coordinator builds the course around scent — it opens with rose-distilled water — and pairs it with wine or with non-alcoholic aroma drinks made by herb distillation. Fish, foie gras, game and flower-strewn plates; one diner found the meat sauces rich. Lunch with four pairings is a little over ¥12,000; 10% service. English spoken. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a "unique style: chef × herb coordinator × sommelier"; a chef's course viewed over the kitchen and courtyard, paired with wines by the sommelier or with aroma pairings created by herb distillation. Reviewers in 2026 describe a warm owner greeting guests (February 2026), a team of male staff (September 2026) and a dining room opened up by removing part of the first-floor ceiling of a two-storey house (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The chef's wish is for you to enjoy your meal time to the fullest" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Aroma pairings; rose-water welcome.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner took the full non-alcoholic pairing — kombucha and other drinks standing in for the acidity of white wine, the tannins of red and the sweetness of port — and called it the right decision.
"The sauce for the meat dishes was a bit too rich for my taste, as I'm not fond of spices" — July 2026.
A September 2026 guest found a vegetable mentioned as disliked still appeared in one dish — a small piece, eaten anyway.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・創作料理、中京区東洞院二条上ル壺屋町512-2、地下鉄丸太町駅から徒歩4分、昼 12:00〜15:00 (料理L.O.13:00)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (料理L.O.19:00)、月曜休み (祝日は営業)、完全予約制、サービス料10%、12席、6名以上で貸切可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー・英語のスタッフ、シェフ兼ハーブコーディネーター、ソムリエのワインペアリング、ハーブ蒸留のアロマペアリング (ノンアルコール)。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月、英語): 町家を改装、ダマスクローズの香りの水、Shinshu salmon とキャビア、Yamato tachibana、鱧、まぐろのタルタル、牡蠣のフラン、フォアグラのテリーヌ、ヒグマ、ふぐのジュレ、チーズの盛り合わせ、焼き菓子、昼は4種のペアリングで12,000円あまり。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); reservation only; 10% service.

kyoto_da_ciro.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the restaurant cannot handle dietary needs or allergies raised on the day (Tabelog). Courses include fresh pasta, focaccia, pizza fritta and baked sweets (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_da_ciro.vegan_detail: Not vegan as served: vegetable-led courses but with fish, meat, cheese and cured meats in most dishes (2025–26 reviews). Ask when booking.
kyoto_da_ciro.hours_raw: Lunch Tue–Sun and holidays from 12:00 (12:00–15:00); dinner Tue–Sat and holidays, starting at 18:00 or 19:00 (to 22:00); no dinner on Sunday; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservation only; tell the restaurant of any dietary needs or allergies, including companions’, when booking — none can be handled on the day (Tabelog). Courses: lunch ¥7,500 (7 dishes), lunch with five-drink pairing ¥12,700 (non-alcoholic ¥9,900), dinner ¥15,730 (9 dishes) (Tabelog). Service charge 5% at lunch, 10% at dinner (Tabelog, Japanese text). À la carte on two days every two months (July 2026). 9 counter seats on the fifth floor; private hire; non-smoking, smoking space available; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 25 April 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_da_ciro.notes: [Creative Italian · Gion, a sommelier-chef's nine-seat counter] A quiet fifth-floor counter north of Shijo where the owner-chef, also a sommelier, builds playful seasonal courses around vegetables — a corn soup served with corn pizza and corn gelato, figs four ways, cold pasta with peach and burrata — then lets you choose the size of the final pasta by the 10 g. Lunch ¥7,500, dinner ¥15,730, with wine or non-alcoholic pairings; 5–10% service. Give allergies when booking. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a freestyle Italian restaurant where the owner-chef combines techniques and ingredients freely, with wines from a specialist shop and pairing as part of the concept. A May 2026 reviewer notes the chef is also a sommelier; reviewers describe the chef as approachable and often at the counter explaining dishes (May and October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal vegetable courses; pasta by weight; focaccia.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner who could not choose between four white wines was offered two 50 ml pours.
A July 2026 diner found the pairing pours only 50 cc and ordered a glass of white instead.
A July 2026 regular said à la carte is offered on just two days every two months.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・イノベーティブ、東山区祇園町北側266 井澤ビル 5F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、昼 12:00 スタート (12:00〜15:00、火〜日・祝)、夜 18:00 か 19:00 スタート (〜22:00、火〜土・祝)、日曜は夜なし、月曜休み、完全予約制、アレルギーや苦手なものは予約時に (当日は対応不可)、ランチ7,500円、ペアリング付き12,700円 (ノンアルコール9,900円)、ディナー15,730円、サービス料 ランチ5% ディナー10%、カウンター9席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2023年4月25日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 野菜中心の創作コース、ソムリエでもあるシェフ、パスタは10g 単位、フォカッチャの持ち帰り、2か月に2日だけのアラカルト、ペアリングは50cc という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead and give allergies at booking; set course; cards, e-money and QR accepted.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Dietary restrictions and allergies, including companions’, must be given at booking or before arrival; none can be accommodated on the day.

kyoto_kogamo.gf_detail: Ask. Courses include tempura and a soy- or ponzu-seasoned hot pot; grilled duck and horse sashimi are served with condiments and ponzu (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kogamo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a duck and horse-meat restaurant; the hot pot is cooked with duck (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kogamo.hours_raw: 18:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Ingredients are limited, so an early booking or a course is recommended; ask for horse meat when booking, as supply is limited (Tabelog; September 2025). Courses: Kyoto duck salt-grill course ¥7,900, duck hot pot course ¥9,700, horse and duck hot pot course ¥12,900 — the hot pots in autumn and winter (Tabelog). 12 seats at a hinoki counter facing the open kitchen; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards and QR, no e-money (Tabelog). Bookings for one are accepted (September 2026). In a small alley off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; January 2026). Opened 13 July 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kogamo.notes: [Duck & horse meat · Kawaramachi Sanjo, a hinoki counter in an alley] A 12-seat counter tucked off Kawaramachi where the cooks serve Kyoto duck — as yukhoe, sashimi so fresh it barely needs the hot pot, salt-grilled or roasted — alongside tender horse sashimi and liver, with Kyoto vegetables as salad and tempura. In autumn and winter the duck hot pot in a copper pot is the draw. Courses ¥7,900–12,900; ask for horse meat when booking. Solo diners welcome. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): Kyoto vegetables, Kyoto duck and horse meat prepared by chefs specialising in Kyoto cuisine, at a hinoki counter with an open kitchen; opened 13 July 2013. Reviewers note the chef’s care over seasoning and the order of dishes (March 2025) and passion for the ingredients (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto duck; horse sashimi; duck hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A November 2024 diner loved the horse liver but found the menu a little limited.
A September 2026 solo diner felt unwell mid-course; the staff were kind as the diner left early.
A September 2026 diner wished for more dishes unique to the restaurant, as many are simply grilled or in hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 馬肉料理・日本料理・居酒屋、中京区河原町三条下ル大黒町46-1、三条駅から徒歩約3分、火〜日 18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 21:00)、月曜休み、食材に限りがあるため早めの予約かコースを、京鴨の塩焼きコース7,900円、鴨鍋コース9,700円、桜肉と鴨の鍋コース12,900円 (鍋は秋冬)、12席、檜のカウンターとオープンキッチン、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・QR 可、2013年7月13日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 鴨のユッケ、鴨の刺身、桜肉の刺身、レバー刺し、銅鍋の鴨鍋と雑炊、京野菜の天ぷら、生麩の天ぷら、馬肉は予約時に伝えると確実、メニューが少ないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; ask for horse meat when booking; solo diners accepted.

kyoto_sushi_rakumi.gf_detail: Ask. Edomae sushi with soy, marinated fish and sauces, plus cooked dishes such as fried sea bream (2025–26 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_sushi_rakumi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase of fish and shellfish (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_rakumi.hours_raw: Two sittings, starting 17:00 and 19:30, about two hours each; closed Sunday and the second and fourth Mondays — ask about holidays (Tabelog). Reservation only; bookings for the month after next open at the start of each month; cancellation charges 50% three days before, 80% two days before, 100% the day before or on the day (Tabelog). Card payment only, no cash; service charge included in the course price (Tabelog, Japanese text). 8 counter seats of a single slab of cypress, with a waiting room and bar upstairs overlooking the river; private hire (Tabelog; October 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On the Shirakawa north of Shijo; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 11 January 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_rakumi.notes: [Sushi · Gion Shirakawa, Gion Sasaki's sushi counter] An eight-seat cypress counter on the Shirakawa, produced by Gion Sasaki and led by chef Kazuya Nomura, from Toyama. The omakase moves from Kyoto-style small dishes — abalone with its liver risotto, chawanmushi, seasonal sashimi — to Edomae nigiri on red- and white-vinegar rice. A cheerful, chatty counter; on some nights most guests are from abroad (2025). Card only, service included; about ¥20,000–50,000. Two sittings, 17:00 and 19:30.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): sushi chefs trained at Gion Sasaki and Sushi Yoshitake; the sushi concept of Gion Sasaki, blending Kyoto dashi with Edomae technique. An October 2025 reviewer says the chef is from Toyama; reviewers describe a cheerful, friendly chef and a lively counter (October 2025 to October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "learning from the past to create the new."
chef_bio.specialty: Edomae sushi with red- and white-vinegar rice.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner liked the cooking but found the seasoning slightly salty and the sushi, about seven pieces, a little few for a big appetite.
An October 2025 diner found the Akashi sea bream sashimi exquisite but missed explanations of the dishes.
A six-time regular looks forward to the lotus root served with the gari on every visit (November 2025).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司・海鮮・日本料理、東山区三吉町332-6、三条駅から徒歩5分、2部制 (17:00〜、19:30〜、約2時間)、日曜・第2・第4月曜休み、完全予約制、翌々月の予約は月初から、キャンセル料3日前50%・2日前80%・前日と当日100%、カードのみ (現金不可)、サービス料はコース料金に含む、カウンター8席 (一枚板)、2階に待合、貸切可、禁煙、2019年1月11日オープン、祇園さゝ木の寿司、料理人 Kazuya Nomura、京の出汁と江戸前、赤酢と白酢のシャリ。口コミ (2025年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 白川沿い、Toyama 出身の大将、漬けのまぐろ、鮑と肝のリゾット、茶碗蒸し、明るく気さくな店、塩味がやや強いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book two months ahead at the start of the month; card only; strict cancellation fees.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kinmata.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a whole: tempura is central — the lunch tendon, the sesame-tofu tempura and the counter’s fried "uni bread" — alongside a dashi-and-soy kaiseki (2026 reviews). Ask about a kaiseki without fried dishes.
kyoto_kinmata.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a kaiseki built on dashi, with fish and wagyu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kinmata.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–13:30 and dinner 17:30–19:00 are the last seatings (counter lunch to 13:00, counter dinner from 18:00); closed mainly on Wednesday, irregularly — see the calendar on the official site (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; a booking may be cancelled if the guest cannot be reached 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). Service charge 15% (Tabelog, Japanese text). Tatami-room lunch kaiseki ¥10,000, ¥15,000 and ¥20,000 for 2–8 (Tabelog); tempura-bowl lunches ¥2,200–5,750 (March 2026); dinners about ¥20,000–60,000 (March 2026). 50 seats: a 9-seat counter and six tatami rooms for 2 to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Near Nishiki Market; 5 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_kinmata.notes: [Kaiseki · Nishiki, an 1801 inn-turned-kaiseki house] A registered-heritage Kyoto townhouse by Nishiki Market that began in 1801 as an inn for medicine merchants from Omi and still serves kaiseki in tatami rooms around a small courtyard garden. Book a private room for a seasonal kaiseki (lunch from ¥10,000), or sit at the 9-seat counter for the theatrical uni bread and hojicha chazuke — or a tempura-bowl lunch from ¥2,200. Eighth-generation family run; 15% service. Mainly closed Wednesday.

roles: Family-run house; seventh- and eighth-generation owners (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1801 (Kyowa 1) as an inn for medicine merchants from Omi under the name 近江屋; the fourth-generation 又八 renamed it 近又, from 近 of 近江 and 又 of 又八. Reviewers met the seventh- and eighth-generation owners (March 2026) and heard stories from the eighth generation (August 2026); a June 2026 diner had breakfast there before.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kaiseki; sesame-tofu tempura; uni bread.

anecdotes.text: A February 2023 diner who had said at booking that raw fish was a problem was served sea bream sashimi; the owner ran after the diner to apologise.
A March 2026 diner waited about 50 minutes for a tempura bowl while a course guest was served first.
A September 2026 couple, too full to finish, were given the rest of the saury kamameshi as rice balls to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kinmata.com): 創業1801年 (享和元年) の京懐石料理店、登録有形文化財の京町家、近江の国からの薬商人の定宿として始まり、初代又八が「近江屋」として宿を始め、四代目又八の代に「近又」と改名、錦市場の材料、少人数向けのカウンター席「近また」は昼はミニ懐石や天ぷら、夜は天ぷらコースや鉄板焼きを含む料理長の特別コース。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区大日町407、京都河原町駅から徒歩5分、昼 12:00〜13:30・夜 17:30〜19:00 (最終入店、カウンターは昼13:00まで・夜18:00から)、主に水曜不定休、サービス料15％、座敷の昼懐石10,000円・15,000円・20,000円、50席 (カウンター9席と座敷6室)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2023年2月〜2026年9月、英語): 七代目と八代目、天丼のランチ2,200〜5,750円、胡麻豆腐の天ぷら、カウンターの Uni Bread、ほうじ茶の出汁茶漬け、天丼を50分ほど待ったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a tatami room or the counter; staff explain each dish; 15% service charge.

kyoto_jintora_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask. Soft serve with shichimi or sansho mixed in; whether it comes in a cone or a cup, and the cone’s ingredients, are not stated (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_jintora_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: milk soft serve (2026 reviews). The spice blends are sold separately to take home.
kyoto_jintora_nishiki.hours_raw: Official site: 10:00–18:00, open every day except at New Year. Tabelog gives 9:30–18:00. No reservations (Tabelog). Cards and e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). 4 seats for eating in (Tabelog; March 2025). Inside Nishiki Market, 3 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn (official site). Sansho products limited to two bags a person because of scarce supply (official site).
kyoto_jintora_nishiki.notes: [Sweets · Nishiki Market, shichimi soft serve] A Nishiki Market spice shop that has blended shichimi since 1878 and, on the side, swirls it into soft serve: pale pink, sweet at first, then a gentle heat that tickles the throat. There is a sansho version too (¥480 in 2026). Four seats to eat in; buy a jar of yuzu shichimi on the way out. Open daily 10:00–18:00.

roles: Family spice house (operator ぢんとら Co., Ltd.)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Meiji 11 (1878), blending fragrant shichimi passed down from one heir to the next, in Nishiki Market.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto shichimi; shichimi soft serve.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 visitor asked how hot it was; the staff said not very, but that the throat would tingle later — so the visitor cautiously ordered a mixed swirl.
A January 2025 visitor bought three jars of yuzu shichimi as light souvenirs and ended up keeping the jars at home after the family raved about the yuzu shichimi in a hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぢんとら、創業明治11年、一子相伝の七味、中京区中魚屋町494 (錦市場内)、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩3分、10:00〜18:00、無休 (年始は休み)、京七味、一味、柚こしょう、山椒、七味・山椒ソフトクリーム、山椒は入手困難のため1人2袋まで。食べログ: 9:30〜18:00、予約不可、カード・電子マネー可、4席。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 七味ソフトクリーム430円 (2026年7月は480円)、山椒ソフトクリーム480円、ピンク色、甘さのあとに喉にピリッと、柚子七味は約450円。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-up counter in Nishiki Market; four seats.

kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.gf_detail: Ask. Bouillabaisse of fish and shellfish served with focaccia; starters include quiche and pâté; a cutlet in one course; canelé to take away; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a bouillabaisse house built on fish stock, with duck and pâté among the starters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 12:30, drinks 14:00) Thursday–Sunday; dinner 17:00–22:30 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 21:30) Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday and some Tuesdays and Wednesdays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (card details for Tabelog online booking); à la carte bookings on the day only; 100% cancellation fee the day before for the private-room bouillabaisse course (Tabelog). No service charge; one drink per person at dinner (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 13 seats: 7 at the counter, 6 in a sunken-kotatsu private room (Tabelog). Non-smoking; ashtray outside (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Off Takakura north of Bukkoji, 5 min from Shijo and Karasuma Stns (Tabelog). Opened 25 October 2020 (Tabelog).
kyoto_petit_poisson_bouillabaisse.notes: [French bistro · Shijo-Karasuma, Kyoto’s bouillabaisse house] A small counter bistro off Takakura that makes one thing its business: bouillabaisse, rich with seafood and built from fish trimmings. The ¥3,600 lunch brings a crowded starter plate and the day’s bouillabaisse — sea bream, mussels, vegetables — with focaccia; dinner courses add fish starters and a meat main. Take a canelé home. Book ahead (counter seats are few); one drink each at dinner; closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Nice (September 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the chef trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Nice, and the restaurant is listed in Gault&Millau POP. Tabelog gives the opening as 25 October 2020. An October 2026 reviewer took the calm host to be a female owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: The signature bouillabaisse uses fish trimmings that would otherwise be discarded (shop’s Tabelog text).
chef_bio.specialty: Bouillabaisse.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 lunch guest, nervous about French table manners, found there was nothing to worry about.
A November 2026 diner had the chef’s course built around a sweetfish bouillabaisse.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブイヤベースのお店 プチポワソン、ビストロ・フレンチ、下京区高倉通仏光寺上ル西前町374-1、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分、昼11:30〜15:00 (木〜日)、夜17:00〜22:30 (火〜日、料理L.O.20:00)、月曜と一部の火・水休み、予約可、アラカルトは当日予約のみ、サービス料なし、ディナーは1ドリンク制、カード・電子マネー・QR可、13席 (カウンター7、掘りごたつ6)、禁煙、英語メニュー、2020年10月25日オープン。店の取り組み: 捨てられる魚のアラでブイヤベース。口コミ (2026年、英語): 昼のブイヤベースセット3,600円、前菜の盛り合わせ (鴨、豆腐、キッシュ、キャロットラペ、パテ)、鯛のブイヤベース、HANAKAGO のフォカッチャ、持ち帰りのカヌレ、シェフはニースの星付きで修業、Gault&Millau POP。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book ahead; one drink per person at dinner.

kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Fish small plates with white wine; bread with the ajillo and pan con tomate, a monaka-wafer otoshi, fried monkfish, squid-ink rice croquettes and fries are not gluten-free (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-seafood bar (2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–24:00 on weekdays, 14:00–24:00 on weekends and holidays; lunch with white wine is served upstairs at 魚料理あぎやお from 12:00. Tabelog: 17:00–23:00 Monday–Thursday, 12:00–23:00 Friday–Sunday and holidays; irregular closures. Reservations accepted; take care not to book the 2nd-floor restaurant by mistake; ¥7,700 cancellation fee from two days before (Tabelog). Otoshi ¥550 per person (Tabelog, original text). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter, two tables for four, a counter private room for five (room fee ¥2,500) (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children only in the private room (Tabelog). About 10 m east of the Gojo–Higashinotoin crossing, 2 min from Gojo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 3 February 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_agiyao_gojo.notes: [Wine bar · Gojo, fish and white wine] A grown-up bar at Gojo–Higashinotoin built on a simple pairing: seasonal fish and a long list of white wine, poured to your taste. Start with the taiyaki-shaped monaka otoshi, then small plates — sea urchin on pan con tomate, kohada, ajillo with bread, grilled kinmedai, a soup paella. The fish restaurant agiyao is upstairs; book the right floor. ¥550 otoshi; open until midnight.

roles: Owner (named Aoyagi in a September 2026 review), who also runs fish restaurants; kitchen chef (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the owner, Aoyagi, also runs Uo Ryori Aoyagi near Gion and is involved in a wine shop; the sister restaurant 魚料理あぎやお is upstairs in the same building, which an October 2026 reviewer says holds a Michelin star. Tabelog gives the opening as 3 February 2014.
chef_bio.philosophy: Supporting Kyoto’s food culture and local producers with Kyoto ingredients (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Fish small plates with white wine.

anecdotes.text: On a September 2026 day when the chef had just left, the owner was cooking and serving alone, and the lunchtime guest got to eat the owner’s own cooking.
Four friends in October 2026 got through about fifteen glasses of white wine, poured in a considered order.
An October 2026 visitor found the master intimidating at first, then friendly and full of wine recommendations.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: お魚と白ワインのバル agiyao、下京区深草町592-3 1階、旬の魚と豊富な白ワインの大人のバル、京都産の食材で京都の食文化と地元産業を応援、平日17時〜24時、土日祝14時〜24時、白ワインのランチは2階の魚料理あぎやおで12時から。食べログ: 月〜木 17:00〜23:00、金〜日祝 12:00〜23:00、不定休、予約可、2日前からキャンセル料7,700円、お通し550円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、24席 (カウンター8、テーブル4人×2、個室5人、個室料2,500円)、禁煙、2014年2月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 店主の Aoyagi さんは Gion 近くの魚料理店も営む、2階の姉妹店はミシュランの星、たい焼き型の最中のお通し、雲丹のパンコントマテ、アヒージョ、金目鯛の焼き物、スープパエリア、白ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥550 otoshi; book the right floor (bar on 1F, restaurant on 2F); cancellation fee from two days before.

kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of sourdough, croissants, pain de mie and baguette sandwiches (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Croissants, condensed-milk butter bread and sandwiches use dairy, egg and meat; the levain and other lean breads are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.hours_raw: Opens from about 7:00 (sometimes 6:00); the day’s opening time is posted on Instagram; closed Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday (Tabelog; July–October 2026). Closing time not given; long breaks are announced (one until 26 August in 2026). Queues at opening — 40 minutes in July 2026 — easier around 10:00 (2026 reviews). Cash only (Tabelog; July 2026). Takeaway bakery; seats not listed (Tabelog). In a back lane near Nijo Castle, a brick building with a spiral stair, 5–6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Began as an event stall; shop opened at the end of 2019 (October 2026 review).
kyoto_kurs_bakery_nijo.notes: [Bakery · Nijo Castle, hard bread at first light] A hidden bakery in a back lane near Nijo Castle — brick front, spiral stair — that opens around 7 a.m. (check Instagram that morning) and draws a queue for its sourdough, deeply buttery croissants and pain de mie. The sandwiches are the other reason to come: chicken and gorgonzola, a stacked BLT, a ¥1,000 fig fruit sandwich. Cash only; Thursday to Sunday; arrive at opening or around ten.

roles: Baker-owner (unnamed in Tabelog; one review thanks “Masamichi” and the baker’s wife)
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: it began as an event vendor and opened its shop at the end of 2019. Another October 2026 regular thanked "Masamichi and your wife".
chef_bio.specialty: Croissants; sourdough; sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor waited 40 minutes after a 7 a.m. opening and left with twelve items for ¥5,620.
An October 2026 regular calls these the best croissants of a lifetime, rich with butter yet never heavy, and still fairly priced.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: kurs、パン、中京区西大黒町334 コーポラス二条1F、二条城前駅から430m、朝7時から (その日の開店時間は Instagram で)、月・火・水休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 自家製の天然酵母のルヴァン、クロワッサン、テレビで紹介されたパンドミ、鶏とゴルゴンゾーラ500円、BLT650円、クロックマダム550円、いちじくのフルーツサンド1,000円、ソーセージパン600円、行列、現金のみ、イベント出店から始まり2019年末に店舗。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; check Instagram for the opening time; queues at opening.

kyoto_pontocho_sushi_yoshino.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi with soy and sauces, saikyo-miso grilled fish, fried dishes and vinegared dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_sushi_yoshino.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sushi, sashimi, grilled fish and clam soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_sushi_yoshino.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 17:00–22:30; Sat–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:30 (last orders 14:00 and 22:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; the omakase "sushi kaiseki" by the day before; on 30–31 December, course bookings only; families with children under school age contact ahead (Tabelog). 17 seats: 9 at the counter and 8 at tables; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Pontocho near the Kaburenjo theatre, now on the ground floor after moving down from the 2nd floor of the same building; 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_sushi_yoshino.notes: [Sushi · Pontocho] A small sushi counter on Pontocho by the Kaburenjo, now at street level, known as much for its side dishes — vinegared plates, saikyo-miso black cod, a clam soup made to order — as for the sushi. Omakase sushi kaiseki ¥11,000 (book a day ahead) or à la carte; bills around ¥8,000–15,000. Busy with overseas visitors; book. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Listed as opening 9 December 2021 (Tabelog); per the operator, the shop moved from the 2nd floor of its building to the ground floor facing Pontocho. A September 2025 reviewer first visited "7 to 8 years ago".
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi kaiseki; side dishes.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 returnee, back after seven or eight years, was remembered by the owner.
A twelve-time regular in October 2026 noted two hours of "consistently meticulous service".
A May 2026 diner found the staff stretched: one server friendly and full of explanations, another "quite unfriendly"; the ikura was "just okay".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 先斗町寿司よし乃、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、中京区石屋町122-5、三条駅から徒歩5分、月火木金 17:00〜22:30、土日 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜22:30、水曜休み、17席 (カウンター9、テーブル8)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード可、2021年12月9日オープン、ビルの2階から先斗町に面した1階へ移転、おまかせの寿司懐石11,000円 (前日までに予約)。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 鰆の焼き物、銀鱈の西京焼き、三種の酢の物、北寄貝、雲丹、注文ごとの貝の吸い物、穴子の揚げ物、柚子のシャーベット、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; many overseas guests (2025–26 reviews).

kyoto_grand_marble_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Danish bread and pies (2026 reviews).
kyoto_grand_marble_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: butter-laminated Danish bread and butter pies (2026 reviews).
kyoto_grand_marble_gion.hours_raw: 10:30–18:30 daily; a summer break 6–10 July (Tabelog). Mainly a takeaway shop; 4 seats (Tabelog); the café upstairs, カフェ・グランマーブル祇園ちから, serves French toast and croque-monsieur (2026 reviews). Some items sell out by late afternoon (June 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In a Gion machiya; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_grand_marble_gion.notes: [Danish bread · Gion] The Gion flagship of a Kyoto marble-Danish bakery (founded 1996, per a reviewer), in a machiya near Yasaka Shrine: boxed loaves in flavours like matcha-azuki or Kyoto three-colour, which keep about 11 days — a favourite Kyoto gift. Loaves from about ¥1,188; a café upstairs. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a Kyoto marble-Danish specialist founded in 1996, the Danish ranked first in Kyoto City's furusato-tax bread category five years running (August 2026). The official site lists this Gion main shop and a factory shop, with pop-up shops at department stores elsewhere in Japan (November 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Marble Danish bread.

anecdotes.text: By 4 pm on a June 2026 afternoon, some items were already sold out.
A June 2026 regular found the Danish less buttery than remembered, and a little sweet and greasy toasted.
A gift recipient in August 2026 sliced and toasted the plain loaf the next morning as instructed — "crispy and delicious".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (grandmarble.com): GRAND MARBLE、グランマーブル祇園本店、グランマーブル ファクトリー店、大丸福岡天神店と水戸京成百貨店の期間限定ショップ (2026年11月)。食べログ (店舗会員): パン・チョコレート、東山区祇園街南側570-238、祇園四条駅から徒歩約5分、10:30〜18:30 (無休、7月6〜10日は夏季休業)、4席、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2026年6〜9月、英語): マーブルデニッシュ、Prestige 1,188円、抹茶あん、抹茶黒蜜、Kyoto Sanshoku、黒糖ミルクきなこ、焦がし砂糖のバターパイ783円、賞味期限11日、2階はカフェ・グランマーブル祇園ちから、1996年創業、ふるさと納税のパン部門で5年連続1位。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick boxed loaves at the counter; go early for the full range.

existence.note: Official site (November 2026 news) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_joko_ya.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, fried shrimp and squid tempura, oden broth and sushi; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_joko_ya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led izakaya; even the cold tomato oden sits in broth (2026 reviews).
kyoto_joko_ya.hours_raw: 17:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); 2nd-floor seats to 22:30 (last order 22:00); closed over New Year and in summer, and on some days (e.g. 8 October) (official site; Tabelog). Starter charge ¥330 per person — Tabelog's Japanese original: "付き出し330円". Bookings taken; walk-ins sometimes possible (September 2026). Counter on the ground floor, tables with sunken footwells upstairs: 21 seats per Tabelog, 22 per the official site; children basically not admitted; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog; official site). In a machiya on Nishinotoin south of Takoyakushi; 6 min from Karasuma or Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_joko_ya.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinotoin near Shijo-Karasuma] A machiya izakaya where the owner, from Kyotango on the Japan Sea, serves fish and sake from home: salt-seared sawara, crisp gasa shrimp, saba sushi to finish. Counter downstairs, sunken tables upstairs; ¥330 starter; about ¥5,000–8,000. Popular — book. Open to 23:30.

chef_bio.background: Opened 31 August 2016 (Tabelog). Per the official site: a Japanese izakaya near Shijo-Karasuma serving ingredients and local sake from the owner's hometown, Kyotango. An August 2026 reviewer says the shop is named after the chef's surname and calls it "Kamigoya"; Tabelog romanises it "Joko Ya" and the site is johkoya.com.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyotango fish; grilled saba sushi.

anecdotes.text: A party of three in June 2026 had the sashimi platter sized for three.

An October 2026 diner found the fish not very fatty that season, and the fried gasa shrimp heavily seasoned — "more like a snack" — which "might actually be a good thing"; locals and tourists were about half and half.
A September 2026 regular overate again: the saba sushi at the end was "a bit too much".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (johkoya.com): 上古屋、京都 四条/烏丸駅にほど近い西洞院蛸薬師の和食居酒屋、店主の地元である京丹後の食材や地酒、17:30〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、2階席は22:30まで (L.O. 22:00)、年末年始と夏季休業、10月8日休み、22席 (カウンター8、テーブル14)。食べログ (店舗会員): 居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、中京区西洞院蛸薬師下ル古西町427、付き出し330円、21席、子供は基本的に不可、2016年8月31日オープン。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): 京丹後と舞鶴の魚、京都の鰆の塩たたき、刺身の盛り合わせ、ガサエビの唐揚げ、げそ天、焼き鯖寿司、冷やし真薯、京都のトマトの冷やしおでん、店名は料理人の名字、店主は丹後出身。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; ¥330 starter; adults only, basically.

kyoto_sudo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: "We do not offer vegan, vegetarian, or gluten-free menus", and the course centres on pizza and fresh pasta (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sudo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan or vegetarian menu (Tabelog).
kyoto_sudo.hours_raw: Tue–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:30; Sun 12:00–14:30 and 18:30–22:30; closed Monday and on some other days (Tabelog). Reservation only; the course can take 2–3 hours (Tabelog; August 2026). Service charge 5% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サーヴィス料 5%". BYO with a corkage fee (Tabelog). 9 counter seats; private hire up to 20; children of school age eating an adult course; no strong perfume or very casual clothes; sommelier; non-smoking; cards incl. UnionPay (Tabelog). Takeaway of leftover pizza (October 2026). On Nijo-dori east of Fuyacho; 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sudo.notes: [Italian omakase & pizza · Nijo-Fuyacho] A nine-seat counter opened in 2025 where a chef with a Japanese-cuisine background cooks a long seasonal omakase, with Neapolitan pizza from the oven in front of you. Courses ¥6,600 (+5% service), lunch on Sundays; wine pairings. Allow 2–3 hours. No vegan, vegetarian or gluten-free menus. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; background in Japanese cuisine per the operator and 2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Opened 10 November 2025 (Tabelog). Per the operator: Italian cooking shaped by the chef's experience in Japanese cuisine. A July 2026 reviewer calls it a restaurant produced by "etto"; an October 2026 reviewer says the chef prepares everything alone, so dishes come at a leisurely pace.
chef_bio.specialty: Pizza within an omakase.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner booked for 7:30 pm and left at 10:30.
An October 2026 visitor took home the leftover pizza, after a bonito pizza that "was incredibly delicious".
An October 2026 diner found the course a bit oily and salty overall, with two similar slices of pizza, though the dessert was delicious.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Sudo、ピザ・イタリアン、中京区二条通麩屋町東入尾張町202-1 オーク二条、京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、火〜土・祝 18:00〜22:30、日 12:00〜14:30・18:30〜22:30、月曜休み (ほかに休みあり)、完全予約制、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーのメニューなし、サーヴィス料5%、9席 (カウンター)、持ち込み可 (持ち込み料あり)、小学生以上、2025年11月10日オープン、和食の経験を生かしたイタリアン、イタリア製のピザ窯、ワイン約100種、季節のおまかせ6,600円、ランチ6,600円、クリスマス11,000円。口コミ (2026年7〜10月、英語): 鰹のピザ、枝豆のジェノベーゼ、キタッラ、からすみのペペロンチーノ、etto のプロデュース、料理人一人で調理、2〜3時間のコース。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; allow 2–3 hours; 5% service.

kyoto_miyagawacho_hotta.gf_detail: Ask when booking. An omakase of Kyoto cooking with dashi, soy and miso, plus a beef cutlet sandwich, somen, a mini ramen and nama-fu in some seasons; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_miyagawacho_hotta.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led omakase with dashi, beef cutlet, eel and crab (2026 reviews).
kyoto_miyagawacho_hotta.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Monday to Saturday, last entry 20:30; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog); the Michelin Guide gives Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–23:00, closed Monday and Sunday. Reservation only; the phone may go unanswered during service (Tabelog); one omakase with everyone starting together (March 2026). Omakase ¥26,400 or ¥28,600, service and tax included (TableCheck). Tabelog’s English page says a service charge is added, but its Japanese original reads なし. 8 counter seats; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; junior-high age and up; cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay and others), no e-money (Tabelog). English menu; sommelier; BYO; take-away beef cutlet sandwich (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). On the stone-paved Miyagawa-suji among teahouses; 4 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; Michelin Guide). Opened 14 June 2023 (Tabelog; a July 2026 reviewer says 2022).
kyoto_miyagawacho_hotta.notes: [Kaiseki · Miyagawacho, a playful Kyoto counter] An eight-seat counter on Miyagawacho's stone-paved lane of teahouses, run by a chef-sommelier who trained at Gion Sasaki. The omakase (about ¥26,400–28,600) moves from classic Kyoto dishes — fugu broth over grilled fins, house karasumi on rice, hamo and ayu in summer — to playful turns such as fugu milt with truffle, a mini seafood ramen and the signature fillet beef cutlet sandwich, before donabe rice. Diners in May 2026 found the entrance full of flowers for a new Michelin star. Everyone starts together; book ahead. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: The invoice register lists an individual, 堀田 功雄, for the shop’s invoice number. Per 2026 reviewers: the chef trained at Gion Sasaki (January and March 2026); a July 2026 reviewer adds that the chef is a sommelier and ran Sasaki’s sister restaurant BAR Kappo before going independent. Reviewers in May and July 2026 report a first Michelin star in the 2026 guide; the Michelin Guide page praises the unconventional flow with a beef cutlet and the owner’s handiwork. Opened 14 June 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Michelin Guide: cooking not bound by formality, with ideas that look unconventional at first — "格式に縛られない料理".
chef_bio.specialty: Fillet beef cutlet sandwich; house karasumi; seasonal donabe rice.

anecdotes.text: Two diners in May 2026 found the entrance full of flowers celebrating a new Michelin star.
A January 2026 guest watched the chef grill tiger-fugu fins over charcoal and pour fugu dashi over grilled nama-fu.
A March 2026 diner found the cold first soup’s aftertaste lacking and the dishes tasty but unsurprising, liking the mochi pizza best.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); booking only; everyone starts together.

kyoto_osteria_coccinella.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta is the core of the menu (four or five a night); starters such as carpaccio, terrines and cheese may suit, but no gluten information is published (official menu).
kyoto_osteria_coccinella.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, meat and cheese starters, meat ragù pasta and mains; a garlic peperoncino or tomato pomodoro pasta is on the sample menu, but no ingredient list is published (official menu).
kyoto_osteria_coccinella.hours_raw: 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00) Tuesday to Sunday; holidays 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Monday, plus a run of days off once a month (Tabelog; official site; the official shop page lists Tuesday–Thursday). Table charge ¥300 (Tabelog’s Japanese original: 300円). Bookings taken; also welcome as a second-stop wine bar (official site). Seats: 21 per the official site (12 at tables, 9 at the counter), 19 per Tabelog; non-smoking. Cards: the official site says not accepted, Tabelog lists cards and PayPay. In a renovated townhouse on Takakura-dori east of Bukkoji; 5 min from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma Stn (official site).
kyoto_osteria_coccinella.notes: [Italian · Shijo-Karasuma, pasta and 500 wines in a townhouse] A wood-warm osteria in a renovated townhouse off Bukkoji-dori, where the owner-chef cooks simple Italian dishes with a twist — about ten starters of terrines, carpaccio and cheese, then four or five pastas from a ¥1,200 garlic peperoncino to lamb cacio e pepe or duck ragù — with some 500 wines to choose from. Regulars call it a pasta place worth returning to; one found it a bit salty. Fine as a second-stop wine bar. ¥300 table charge. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner-chef (店主, official site; the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: The official site signs its greeting 店主 森山 雅彦, and the invoice register lists the same individual. Per the official site: a renovated townhouse full of warm wood, carefully chosen ingredients served simply with small accents, and about 500 wines in stock, chosen to the guest’s wishes. A July 2025 reviewer praises the chef’s skill as a solo operator.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: simple dishes with new pairings and small arrangements, and dishes where the ingredients’ own dashi comes through.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal pasta; terrines; wine.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 regular, on a fifth-plus visit, found the octopus with black hummus left the diner wondering how its umami was made.
A March 2024 diner found the food a bit salty and hoped it could be toned down.
A January 2026 diner liked the duck pâté, which a child also enjoyed, but felt hesitant to bring the family, accepting the shop has its own policy.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (coccinella77.com): 京都市下京区のイタリアン Osteria Coccinella、町屋を改装した木のぬくもり溢れる店内、厳選した食材をシンプルにちょっとしたアクセント、ワインは500本以上、二軒目のワインバーとしても、店主 森山 雅彦、メニュー (一例): 前菜約10品 (天然ブリのカルパッチョ1,400円、牡蠣のソテー レモンバターソース1,400円、イチジクと羊のフェタチーズ1,400円、仔羊のテリーヌ・軍鶏のテリーヌ900円、大山豚うで肉の田舎風パテ700円)、パスタ4〜5品 (大江農園のトマト ポモドーロ1,300円、スペイン産にんにくペペロンチーノ1,200円、カルボナーラ1,300円、紅ズワイガニのアラビアータ1,800円、仔羊のカチョエペペ1,800円、黒毛和牛ブリスケのボロネーゼ1,800円、シャラン鴨のラグー1,800円)、下京区高倉通仏光寺東入ル新開町397-2、18:00〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、月曜定休 (月1回連休)、21席 (テーブル12、カウンター9)、クレジットカード利用不可。食べログ: イタリアン・ワインバー・バル、火〜日 18:00〜23:30、祝日 18:00〜23:00、チャージ300円、19席、禁煙、カード・PayPay 可、インボイス: 森山 雅彦 (個人)。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語)。

kyoto_monk_philosophers_path.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the course opens and ends with wood-fired pizza of Japanese wheat and natural yeast (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_monk_philosophers_path.vegan_detail: Ask. The cooking is centred on vegetables from Ohara farms, but the course also has fish, meat, cheese and dairy desserts; no vegan course is published (yousakana.jp; 2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_monk_philosophers_path.hours_raw: Dinner from 17:30, last order 20:30; closed Monday (yousakana.jp, the restaurant’s own text); Tabelog gives 17:00–20:30 Tuesday to Saturday, closed Monday and Sunday. One omakase course built from the day’s ingredients, ¥15,400 (March and July 2026). Book well ahead — a March 2026 diner booked two months out; mostly overseas guests (2024–26 reviews). 14 seats: 6 at the counter facing the wood-fired oven and two tables for four; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners cards (Tabelog; March 2026). A detached house on the Philosopher’s Path near Ginkakuji; about 1.7 km from Keage Stn, narrow streets for cars (Tabelog; June 2024). Opened December 2015 (October 2023 review).
kyoto_monk_philosophers_path.notes: [Italian · Philosopher's Path, wood-fired vegetables and pizza] A fourteen-seat restaurant in a house on the Philosopher's Path, where chef 今井 義浩 (Imai) cooks nearly everything in a wood-fired oven: a plain dough 'suyaki' pizza to start, then vegetables picked up each morning from Ohara farms, fish and seasonal plates, and a closing half-and-half pizza such as shirasu or venison ragù with sansho. One course, about ¥15,400; counter seats face the fire. Featured on Netflix's Chef's Table, it is booked months ahead, mostly by overseas guests. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the restaurant’s own text (on yousakana.jp): a small restaurant on the Philosopher’s Path cooking simple food over live fire, with pizza from the wood-fired oven as the main dish; every morning the chef visits farms in the mountains of Ohara and markets around Kyoto. Tabelog notes the owner-chef paused in January 2020 to focus on writing and reopened in March 2020. Reviewers note the opening in December 2015, training at renowned restaurants abroad including one in Denmark and in California (October 2023), and a Netflix Chef’s Table episode (2024). Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the restaurant: "Is it possible to express the beauty and the life of the vegetable; to invoke such feelings as the sunlight, the moisture of the soil, the blowing of the wind?"
chef_bio.specialty: Wood-fired pizza; Ohara vegetables from the oven.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 regular on a twelfth visit comes with the diner’s mother every season, loving a honey-and-dill dessert.
An April 2024 diner joined an American colleague who had booked after watching Chef’s Table; everyone else in the room was from overseas.
A June 2024 diner drove up and nearly got stuck in the narrow streets, advising a nearby coin park instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: yousakana.jp (店の紹介と店自身の文章): 京都・哲学の道、薪窯のレストラン monk、料理人 (ピザ職人) の今井義浩さん、毎日畑や市場から仕入れた食材を薪窯で、住所 左京区浄土寺下南田町147、17:30〜20:30 (L.O)、その日の食材によるお任せ、定休 月曜、電話 075-748-1154、メインにはピザ、毎日畑や市場から仕入れた食材 (英語の文では毎朝 Ohara の畑と京都の市場へ)。食べログ: イタリアン・ピザ、火〜土 17:00〜20:30、月・日休み、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、禁煙、店主は2020年1月から執筆のため休業し3月に再開、イタリアン WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): コース15,400円、2015年12月開店、Chef’s Table、カウンター6席とテーブル2卓、素焼きのピザ、Ohara の野菜、ハーフ&ハーフのピザ。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly overseas guests and some foreign staff (2024 reviews); book months ahead.

kyoto_scalae_the_thousand.gf_detail: Ask when booking — the hotel asks guests with food allergies to tell staff in advance (press release). Courses include pasta, bread, gnocchi and breaded mains (2026 reviews).
kyoto_scalae_the_thousand.vegan_detail: Ask in advance. Courses use meat, fish, ham and dairy; no vegan course is published (2026 reviews; press releases).
kyoto_scalae_the_thousand.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–10:00 (last order), lunch 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30), dinner 17:30–21:30 (last orders: course 20:00, à la carte 20:30, drinks 21:00); closed Wednesday (except holidays) (hotel press releases, September 2026; Tabelog). Service charge 15% of the pre-tax total from 1 April 2025 (Tabelog’s Japanese original: サービス料15％; also in the hotel’s release). Cancellation 100% from two days before (Tabelog). 110 seats with 3 private rooms (room fee ¥11,000); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; hotel parking (Tabelog; press release). Non-alcoholic tea pairing available (May 2026). On the 2nd floor of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, up the hotel’s grand staircase; 2 min east of JR Kyoto Stn, via underground exit 5 (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_scalae_the_thousand.notes: [Italian · Kyoto Station, hotel Italian up the grand staircase] The Italian restaurant of THE THOUSAND KYOTO, two minutes from Kyoto Station, reached up the hotel's grand staircase. Chef Kenta Shibahara, born in Kyoto and trained at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Naples, cooks seasonal courses that play with texture — corn 'carbonara', Kamo eggplant spaghettini with white miso — paired by a sommelier team known for competition results. Lunch courses are the easy way in; 15% service on top. 110 seats and private rooms; closed Wednesday.

World’s Best Sommelier semi-finalist, fifth in 2023) and chef-sommelier 沖中 亮真 (press release). Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the press release: "素材自然回帰" — a return to the ingredient and its producer, seeking flavour rooted in harmony.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal Italian courses with wine or tea pairings.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 lunch guest chose a non-alcoholic tea pairing, each tea matched to a dish.
A July 2026 diner was frustrated that the drink menu was slow and nobody explained the bread, olive oil or refills.
A May 2026 diner found the drinks pricey and wished for more reasonable options.

kyoto_hyaku_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden and dashimaki on dashi, fried chicken, sausages and sushi (2025–2026 reviews).

kyoto_hyaku_nishiki.notes: [Standing bar · Nishiki behind Daimaru, from ¥110] A cash-only standing bar on Nishiki-koji opposite Daimaru that opens mid-afternoon: buy tickets, then order oden, fluffy dashimaki, kushikatsu and fried chicken at ¥110–330 a plate. Weekend happy hour brings a medium bottle of beer for ¥440. Regulars note the draft beer doubled to ¥440 in a smaller glass and the counter of ready-made side dishes is gone (2025–2026); one found the sushi rice too big. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: A pre-pay standing bar on Nishiki-koji in front of Daimaru Kyoto, open from mid-afternoon (Tabelog; 2021–2026 reviews). A February 2026 diner heard that, depending on timing, the kitchen may make omurice. Regulars in July 2025 and July 2026 noticed the ready-made side dishes once lined up at the back were gone, while the ticket books were still sold.
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; dashimaki; ¥110 snacks.

anecdotes.text: "When I came back, I found that the draft beer had doubled in price to JPY 440!" — July 2025, after three and a half years away; the glass is also smaller than usual.
A June 2026 drinker on a sixth stop of the afternoon paid ¥550 for a medium bottle of beer and pickled plum with mustard greens.
"The rice was quite large, making it a bit difficult for women to eat comfortably." — April 2026, on the sushi.

kyoto_gion_ichirinka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; a Chinese menu of soy- and black-vinegar-sauced dishes, dumplings, noodles and a sweet-and-sour dish of wheat-gluten namafu (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ichirinka.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the signatures are shrimp chili, mapo tofu, sweet-and-sour pork, beef tendon and shark-fin soup (2025–2026 reviews).

kyoto_gion_ichirinka.notes: [Chinese · Gion, open till 2:30 am] A calm wood-and-Chinese room in a Gion alley that serves creative Chinese food and wine until 2:30 in the morning. Diners praise the shrimp chili, mapo tofu, black-vinegar pork and a sweet-and-sour dish of namafu, plated per person, and a sommelier who pairs wine. Most guests are locals from Gion, so book early; reviewers call the value outstanding for the area. Lunch only by booking three days ahead. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 January 2016 (Tabelog). A January 2025 regular writes that the food is created by a renowned chef from a famous hotel. A November 2024 diner notes most customers are from the Gion area; a June 2025 diner describes a calm Japanese-modern room of warm wood with Chinese touches on the ground floor of the 吉村ビル.
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp chili; mapo tofu; black-vinegar pork; sweet-and-sour namafu.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 first-timer arrived after 1 am, having heard it stays open late, and was welcomed and guided through the menu.

A July 2025 regular orders the sweet-and-sour namafu every time.

kyoto_lino_karasuma_oike.vegan_detail: Ask. The courses run through cured ham, sardines, sea urchin, conger eel, duck and horse meat (2026 reviews); no vegetarian options are listed.

kyoto_lino_karasuma_oike.notes: [Italian · west of Karasuma Oike, sea-urchin pasta] A 22-seat Italian dining room tucked into a residential street near Karasuma Oike, known for its sea-urchin oil pasta. Diners praise light, surprising combinations — sardines with orange, horse-meat tagliata, sawara in kadaif — and careful explanations. ¥500 seat charge à la carte; no preschoolers. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 12 May 2017 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe it appearing suddenly in a residential area, with a counter and tables, a signature sea-urchin pasta always on the menu, and staff who explain each dish. A July 2026 diner who booked the wrong date was still given the omakase course.
chef_bio.specialty: Sea-urchin oil pasta; pasta-and-risotto lunch.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 diner who had mistakenly booked the wrong date was still served the omakase course.
A third-time visitor who prefers oil-based sea-urchin pasta to cream calls this one of the few places that always has it (July 2026).

kyoto_yakitori_hisadori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant — skewers, sashimi, tataki and offal (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).

kyoto_yakitori_hisadori.notes: [Yakitori · by City Hall, one cook, Takasaka chicken] A dim, stylish third-floor counter south of City Hall where the owner, cooking alone, grills premium chicken — Takasaka above all — and serves it as sashimi and tataki too: white-liver sashimi and thigh tataki are the talk. kyoto_namasoba_daikokuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba and udon in soy-based dashi, tempura, curry nanban and nabeyaki (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_namasoba_daikokuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every bowl is built on the house dashi, with herring, chicken, egg, kamaboko and shrimp tempura among the toppings (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_namasoba_daikokuya.hours_raw: 11:00–19:00 (last order 18:30), open straight through; closed Monday — if Monday is a holiday, open and closed Tuesday instead — and occasionally (official site; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the counter and 10 at tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR, including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). English menu with photos (Tabelog). Higashinotoin south of Ayanokoji; 3 min walk from Shijo Stn exit 3 (Tabelog). Founded 1916; closed at the end of 2024 and reopened here on 12 December 2025 (official site).
kyoto_namasoba_daikokuya.notes: [Soba · Higashinotoin, a 1916 soba house reborn] A soba and udon house founded in 1916, long in Pontocho and later in Daimaru, that closed at the end of 2024 and reopened in December 2025 in a new wooden shop near Shijo — with the old head chef, cookware and signboard, after a crowdfunding drive. Tempura zaru, nishin, kitsune, okame and seasonal bowls run about ¥1,400–1,900; some find it a little dear. English menu; cards and QR. Open 11:00–19:00. Closed Monday.

roles: Head chef of the former Daikokuya (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in Taisho 5 (1916), Daikokuya quietly closed at the end of 2024 after 109 years; inheriting the former head chef, the cooking tools and the signboard, it reopened on 12 December 2025 as the new Daikokuya, with the shop's Daikokuten statue at the door. Reviewers in 2026 recall the old shop near the Pontocho Kaburenjo and in Daimaru, and a revival through crowdfunding with former members returning (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "A shop local people can drop into casually while out shopping" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Tempura zaru soba; seasonal soba.

anecdotes.text: "In the final days before Daimaru closed, the flavor of the broth was lacking, but it seems to be returning to its former glory." — August 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the noodles so long that a single chopstick-lift could not take the whole portion.
"While it's delicious, the prices are a bit high, making it less suitable for regular visits." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 生そば 大黒屋、大正5年創業、109年の歴史を経て2024年末にいったん閉店、旧大黒屋の料理長・調理器具・看板を受け継ぎ2025年12月12日に新生大黒屋として再開、店名は大黒天にちなみ大黒天像も引き継ぐ、下京区東洞院通綾小路下る扇酒屋町287、11:00〜19:00 (L.O.18:30)、月曜定休、天ざる・ざる・なめこ・いもかけ・鶏なんば・きつね・にしん・カレーなんば・なべ焼き、季節のすだちそば・鱧天ざる・冷やしきつね・山菜そば・鶏そば。食べログ: そば・うどん、四条駅3番出口から徒歩3分、予約不可、20席、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、英語メニュー。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 天ざる1,900円、大ざる1,400円、おかめ (しっぽく) 1,400円、天丼ハーフ1,450円、木の葉丼、玉子丼、以前は先斗町や大丸に、クラウドファンディングで復活、やや高いとの声。

kyoto_urayama_kyoshoku.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a kushiage restaurant — the courses centre on battered, deep-fried skewers and finish with curry (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_urayama_kyoshoku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kushiage courses with fish, meat and seafood, crab-miso dip and seared tuna (2026 reviews).
kyoto_urayama_kyoshoku.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday, with closures and openings posted month by month — for November 2026, closed 1, 8, 15, 23 (Monday holiday) and 29, and open Sunday 22 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; call for 5 or more, or when online booking is full (Tabelog); counters fill by 19:00 (October 2026). One drink per guest required (Tabelog original 当店全てのお客様にワンドリンク制をお願いしております). Courses, e.g. ¥6,800 (August 2026), or à la carte (Tabelog). 26 seats: 12 at the counter, a private room for up to 6 and a semi-private room for 4–8 upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse down a narrow alley off Shijo Karasuma; 2 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_urayama_kyoshoku.notes: [Kushiage · Shijo Karasuma alley, creative skewers] A renovated townhouse down a back alley near Shijo Karasuma serving creative, seasonal kushiage in courses — light-battered skewers between small Kyoto dishes, a vegetable platter with crab-miso bagna cauda, and a bite of curry to finish — for about ¥6,000–8,000 with drinks. Counter downstairs, private rooms up. Book: the counter fills by seven. One drink per guest. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: after 14 years in Shijo Teramachi, the restaurant reopened under the new name Urayama Kyoshoku with a new menu; the Tabelog opening date is 15 December 2020. Reviewers in 2026 describe chefs working in view of the counter, staff explaining each skewer "as if we were at a sushi restaurant", and a nearly full house run efficiently.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal ingredients highlighted in creative skewers (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kushiage; crab-miso bagna cauda.

anecdotes.text: "The staff explained the different ingredients as if we were at a sushi restaurant." — October 2026.
"I expected the bill for two people to exceed JPY 10,000, but when I asked for the check, it was around JPY 8,000" — October 2026.
"The final curry was a bit heavy; perhaps a chazuke would have been better." — August 2026.
"However, the counter seats on the right side felt a bit hectic and not very relaxing." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・串揚げ・洋食、中京区占出山町310-20、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 17:00〜23:00、日曜休み (11月は1・8・15・23・29日休み、22日 (日) は営業)、予約可 (5名以上や満席時は電話で)、ワンドリンク制、26席 (カウンター12、個室 (6名まで)、半個室)、禁煙、カード可、四条寺町で14年営業したのち店名を変えて再開、季節の創作串揚げと和洋の料理、コースとアラカルト。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): コース6,800円、串8本と季節の料理のコース、山芋と鱧、蟹味噌のディップ、まぐろのたたき、野菜の盛り合わせとバーニャカウダ、締めのひと口カレー、町家を改装、路地の奥、19時には満席。

kyoto_this_is_ormary_store.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery standing bar — every plate comes with the house wheat breads (focaccia, epi, pizza) (2026 reviews).
kyoto_this_is_ormary_store.vegan_detail: Ask. Breads are sold to take away, but the plates are pâté, rillettes, ham, duck, fish and cheese, and some breads contain bacon and cheese (2026 reviews).
kyoto_this_is_ormary_store.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday to Sunday 12:00–20:00, open straight through; closed Tuesday and occasionally without notice — check Instagram; breakfast from 08:00 on some days (Tabelog; July 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); queues can form at opening (October 2026). Standing room plus bench and L-shaped table seating (July 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards for purchases of ¥3,000 or more (Tabelog). Bread to take away (2026 reviews). A renovated machiya with glass walls in a lane north of Shosei-en, near Tominokoji Rokujo; 5–8 min walk from Gojo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 5 October 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_this_is_ormary_store.notes: [Bread and wine bar · north of Shosei-en, a bakery to drink in] A glass-fronted machiya near Gojo that is half bakery, half standing bar: hot house breads — focaccia, epi, bacon-and-cheese — alongside platters of pâté, duck with colatura, ham tonnato and fritters, with wine from noon to 8 pm. A five-dish platter is ¥2,000; drinks are not standing-bar cheap. Breads to take away. Smoking allowed; cards only from ¥3,000. Closed Tuesday and sometimes without notice.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a standing bar and bakery opened 5 October 2023, with occasional breakfast service from 8:00. Reviewers in 2026 describe freshly baked bread served hot, a renovated machiya with glass walls, quick crowds at opening, and unannounced closures posted on Instagram.
chef_bio.specialty: House bread with small plates; 5-dish platter.

anecdotes.text: "I once tried to visit on a snowy day, but it was unexpectedly closed." — July 2026; the reviewer now checks Instagram first.
A July 2026 visitor rated the duck with Kyoto eggplant and colatura the standout, and noticed many guests buying bread to take home.
"The drinks are not cheap for a standing bar, so even for one person, the total can add up." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 立ち飲み・パン、下京区富小路六条上る本塩竈町533-3、月・水〜日 12:00〜20:00、火曜と不定休、朝8時からの営業も不定期、予約可、喫煙可、カードは3,000円以上、2023年10月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): 五条駅から徒歩5〜8分、Shosei-en の北の路地、ガラス張りの町家、パンを主役にした立ち飲み、5品盛り合わせ2,000円 (パテ・ド・カンパーニュ、鴨と京都の茄子のコラトゥーラ、ぶりとババガヌーシュ、自家製ハムのツナソース、フリット)、3品盛り、フォカッチャ、エピ、ベーコンとチーズのパン、持ち帰りも、酒は安くない、臨時休業はインスタで。

cultural_comfort.note: Order the platter and bread at the counter; smoking allowed; cards only from ¥3,000.

kyoto_matsuoka_matsubara.gf_detail: Ask. Traditional Japanese courses and à la carte built on dashi, with fried dishes (whole fried goby, fried rockfish bones) included; no gluten information (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_matsuoka_matsubara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood courses on dashi (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_matsuoka_matsubara.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; a private room with a garden view, by request (Tabelog; June 2023). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). Takeaway available (April 2024). On Matsubara-dori west of Yamato-oji, just east of Miyagawa-cho, 387 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; August 2024). Opened 26 April 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_matsuoka_matsubara.notes: [Japanese · Miyagawa-cho, an eight-seat counter for seafood] A quiet counter on Matsubara just east of the Miyagawa-cho geisha quarter, with a garden-view private room on request. Order omakase or à la carte: rockfish carved live into sashimi, grilled nodoguro, hamo and matsutake soup in late summer, the spring Hanakansho hot pot, and dashimaki or ochazuke to finish. Not cheap — ¥15,000–30,000 a head in reviews — and one 2025 diner felt pushed toward pricey items. Open to midnight; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 26 April 2012. Reviewers describe faithful traditional Japanese cooking; a 2017 diner came for a meal with geisha.
chef_bio.specialty: Hanasansho hot pot; grilled nodoguro.

anecdotes.text: An April 2024 regular comes every year for the Hanakansho hot pot, and this time watched a live rockfish turned into sashimi, its liver served and its bones fried.
A November 2025 couple spent ¥56,000 for two and felt the chef kept recommending expensive items and talked so much that there was little time to savour the food.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: まつおか、日本料理、東山区松原通大和大路西入ル弓矢町25、清水五条駅から387m、17:00〜24:00、水曜休み、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、8席、個室あり (要相談)、分煙、2012年4月26日オープン。口コミ (2017〜2025年、英語): 宮川町の東、伝統的な日本料理、毛蟹、鱧、鯛の塩焼き、松茸、生きたロックフィッシュの造り、Hanakansho の鍋、のどぐろの焼き物、なめろう、うざく、だし巻き、お茶漬け、持ち帰り (塩をした鯛、ハゼの唐揚げ)、1人15,000〜30,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; à la carte prices add up; book ahead.

kyoto_hamacho_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto-style dishes of fish, sesame tofu, yuba, nama-fu (wheat gluten) and obanzai, with fried items such as shrimp-gyoza spring rolls, croquettes and fried yuba; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hamacho_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the menu is mostly fish and meat on dashi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_hamacho_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–23:00, irregular closures (8 November 2026 announced); lunch 12:00–15:00 by reservation only, courses only. Tabelog lists 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 daily. Reservations from 12:30 (official site). Private rooms ¥300 a head (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 100 seats over three floors: counter and semi-private rooms on the first, a bar counter and sunken kotatsu on the second, private rooms on the third; groups up to 55 (Tabelog; April 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). English site. By the Takase River, first lane north of Sanjo on Kiyamachi, west side; 3 min from Keihan Sanjo, 2 min from Shiyakusho-mae (official site).
kyoto_hamacho_kiyamachi.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi-Sanjo, Kyoto dishes by the Takase River] A long-running, three-storey izakaya beside the Takase River just north of Sanjo, with counter seats, sunken-kotatsu rooms and private rooms for groups. The daily menu runs to about a hundred dishes — sashimi of the day, sesame tofu, yuba and nama-fu, specialty tsukune, shrimp-gyoza spring rolls — or take a monthly omakase course from ¥5,000. Over fifteen local sakes. Reviews of the banquet courses are mixed. Open 17:00–23:00; lunch by reservation.

roles: Operated by 株式会社 四季企画 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: run by 株式会社 四季企画, with a sister restaurant, 先斗町 よし菜; a February 2025 blog post marks new noren for the entrance, the first in 25 years since opening.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto flavour and the tastes of the four seasons (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi of the day; tsukune; shrimp-gyoza spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 couple who stop in on every Kyoto trip were pleased to be remembered by the staff, and never tire of watching the cooks cut sashimi at the counter.
A May 2026 banquet guest found drinks slow, the sashimi pieces small and the tsukune and spring rolls only average.
A September 2026 diner on a fifth dinner of the day came in at 20:41 just for the ¥700 sea bream rice with yuba sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 四季の味 京都 浜町、中京区河原町通三条上ル恵比須町448-2 (木屋町通三条上ル1筋目西入ル南側、高瀬川畔)、17:00〜23:00、不定休 (2026年11月8日休み)、昼は予約・コースのみ、霜月の月替りおまかせコース5,000円、秋の味覚満喫コース7,000円、秋の京風会席コース9,000円、お得宴会コース3,500円、日替わりの単品、胡麻豆腐、湯葉、生麩、京野菜、おばんざい、地酒15種類以上、姉妹店「先斗町 よし菜」、運営は株式会社 四季企画、開店以来25年ぶりに暖簾を新調 (2025年2月)。食べログ: 100席、個室料1人300円、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、ベジタリアン対応、子ども可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 刺身、つくね、海老餃子春巻、はまちのかま焼き、湯葉あんかけの鯛ご飯700円、飲み放題付きのコース。

cultural_comfort.note: English site; private rooms ¥300 a head; good for groups.

kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_restaurant.gf_detail: Ask. Breakfast courses with yudofu, nama-fu (wheat gluten), Handa somen (wheat), granola and small plates; the herbal soup curry is not described for gluten (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_restaurant.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses include Agu pork or duck shabu-shabu, dashi broth, yogurt, anago and egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_restaurant.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 8:00–13:30 on weekdays; 7:30–15:00 on weekends and holidays. Reservations only, all guests start together, 90-minute sessions; a no-show after 15 minutes may be cancelled (Tabelog). A medicinal herbal soup curry was sold by meal ticket at lunch in June–July 2026. Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats along a 12 m counter, with semi-private rooms for 4–6 (official site; Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children welcome, kids’ menu (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Second floor; a café on the first floor and a one-group villa above (official site). 5 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (official site). Opened 6 April 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ogawa_shoyaku_restaurant.notes: [Breakfast · Nijo Castle, an herbal-tea morning course] A bright second-floor counter, 12 m long, near Nijo Castle, run by an herbal-medicine house, that turns breakfast into a gentle course: mulberry-leaf tea, granola yogurt with kuromoji, creamy yudofu, a small hot pot of duck or Agu pork, a long plate of Kyoto small dishes and Handa somen with karasumi (¥5,500 in 2026). Refillable herbal teas throughout. Reservations only, from 7:30 at weekends; 90-minute sittings.

roles: Run by the herbal-medicine maker 小川生薬 (official site; August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the 京都小川生薬 building has a first-floor café pairing health teas with sweets, this second-floor restaurant, and a one-group villa on the third floor. Tabelog gives the opening as 6 April 2024. An August 2026 reviewer notes the teas as the hospitality of an herbal-medicine manufacturer.
chef_bio.philosophy: To be the place in central Kyoto closest to nature and health, through drink, food and lodging (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Herbal-tea breakfast course; karasumi Handa somen.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 passer-by was drawn in by a sign for herbal soup curry, got the last serving before 2 p.m., and only at home found the place already saved on Tabelog for its breakfast course.
An October 2026 guest at the 7:30 sitting thought the karasumi somen the best dish but wished for a full portion, and finished with grilled rice balls in broth from the hot pot.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都小川生薬、中京区油小路通押小路上る二条油小路町272、2F レストラン、カウンター中心の20席 (12mのカウンター)、半個室、完全予約制、自然の恵みを取り入れたコース仕立ての朝食、平日8:00〜13:30、土日祝7:30〜15:00、1F カフェ (健康茶とお茶菓子)、3F は一日一組の宿泊。食べログ: 90分制、一斉スタート、カード可、禁煙、車椅子可、子ども可、英語メニュー、2024年4月6日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 季節のコース5,500円、桑の葉茶、大麦グラノーラのヨーグルト、湯豆腐、アグー豚や国産鴨のしゃぶしゃぶ、1996年のプーアル茶、京のおばんざい、からすみの半田そうめん、黒文字のジェラート、100種の生薬のスープカレー。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); reservations only, fixed start times; wheelchair accessible.
