kyoto_tsukeyasai_isoism.gf_detail: Ask. Pickled-vegetable plates, dashimaki, clay-pot rice and grills; fried yuba rolls and a meat-wrapped cutlet with demi-glace are not gluten-free; soy koji used as a topping (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsukeyasai_isoism.vegan_detail: Ask. Twelve kinds of pickled vegetables lead the menu, but the plate comes topped with duck, chicken or cheese, the soup and rice use fish and dashi, and the vegetable dishes are not described as plant-only (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tsukeyasai_isoism.hours_raw: Lunch from 11:30 in four seatings (11:30, 12:00, 13:00, 13:30); dinner 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; often fully booked, including weekday lunch and weekends (October 2026). Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; QR accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Counter seating (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Shichijo west of Karasuma, south of Higashi Hongan-ji, 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 18 July 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tsukeyasai_isoism.notes: [Creative izakaya · Kyoto Station, twelve kinds of pickled vegetables] A cheerful spot near Higashi Hongan-ji from the Kyoto izakaya group 五十家, built on “tsukeyasai” — vegetables, many from the group’s own farm, pickled and marinated a dozen ways. Lunch is one set: twelve vegetables with duck, chicken or cheese, a light onion soup and seasonal clay-pot rice. At night add tofu dashimaki, fried yuba and a celery-filled meat cutlet. Lively staff; book ahead, even for weekday lunch.

roles: Operated by the Kyoto izakaya group 五十家 (2026 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers place it in the Gojyuya (五十家) group and call it a sister of “Sumisoudo”; the vegetables come from the group’s own farm (October 2026). Tabelog gives the opening as 18 July 2016.
chef_bio.specialty: Twelve-vegetable pickled plate; seasonal clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 lunch party could not finish the clay-pot mackerel rice, and the staff shaped the last bowlful into a rice ball to take away.
A September 2026 diner had been to about four of the group’s restaurants and still ranked this the favourite, mostly for the staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 漬け野菜 イソイズム、創作料理、下京区七条通烏丸西入中居町114、京都駅から徒歩5分、昼は11:30から4部制 (11:30、12:00、13:00、13:30)、夜17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、QR可、カウンター席、禁煙、2016年7月18日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): 五十家グループ、Sumisoudo の姉妹店、自社農園の京野菜、12種の漬け野菜に鴨や蒸し鶏やチーズ、玉ねぎのスープ、季節の土鍋ご飯 (鯖と Kujo ねぎ)、豆腐のだし巻きと自家製の醤油麹、湯葉の揚げ巻き、水菜の豚バラ巻き、白セロリのレアカツ、コーヒー焼酎。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (lunch in four seatings); family-friendly per reviewers.

kyoto_uotana_fumibun.gf_detail: Ask. A long menu of sashimi, simmered and grilled dishes alongside tempura, kushikatsu and croquettes; soy and dashi throughout (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_uotana_fumibun.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood kappo-izakaya; even the vegetable dishes come in dashi or white-miso dressings (2025–26 reviews). Tabelog’s vegetarian tick is not evidence.
kyoto_uotana_fumibun.hours_raw: 16:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); it fills up by early evening (May 2026). À la carte from a long menu, or courses (2025 reviews). 34 seats: 8 at the counter, 6 on a raised tatami area, 20 at tables; private hire up to 23 (Tabelog). Smoking area for heated tobacco outside (Tabelog). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). In the basement of a building between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, behind a heavy door; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_uotana_fumibun.notes: [Kappo-izakaya · Sanjo Kiyamachi, Akashi seafood down the stairs] A basement kappo-izakaya behind a heavy door between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, open more than 30 years. Seafood comes daily from Akashi: the grilled anago is the signature, with octopus as sashimi or tempura, simmered sea bream and a dashi omelette in broth. The long menu runs from seasonal small plates to croquettes and kushikatsu, with about 40 sakes. Opens at 16:00 daily; book for the evening.

roles: Owner and chef (unnamed); a younger owner also serves (May 2026)
chef_bio.background: An August 2026 reviewer says the restaurant has over 30 years of history; an October 2025 reviewer says the dishes are now cooked by a chef who took over from the previous owner. A July 2025 regular praises the chef and the owner; a May 2026 diner was served by "the owner and the young owner".
chef_bio.specialty: Grilled Akashi anago; seasonal small plates.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner had several dishes arrive at once, so the grilled anago went cold.
An August 2025 diner returned to a restaurant a late father used to visit, for the sea bream simmered in soy.
A December 2025 diner found the course a bit pricey but the staff lively and welcoming.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区三条木屋町石屋町121 先斗町松嶋屋ビル B1F、三条駅から徒歩3分、16:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、年中無休、予約可、34席 (カウンター8、小上がり6、テーブル20)、貸切可 (23名まで)、屋外に加熱式たばこの喫煙所、カード・QR 可、Akashi の港から毎日届く魚、全国の地酒40種・焼酎30種、Tanba のワイン、名物は Akashi の焼き穴子。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 地下の隠れ家、30年以上、先代から継いだ料理人、Akashi の蛸、鯛のあら炊き、だし巻き、黒豆のコロッケ、かぶら蒸し、料理が一度に来て冷めたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Long Japanese menu, order à la carte or a course; book for evenings; cards and QR.

kyoto_shukura_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Sake is generally gluten-free, but the snacks include oden, soba and grilled heshiko with soy-based seasonings (2023–25 reviews).
kyoto_shukura_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. A sake bar; the snacks include fish (heshiko), clams, oden and soba in broth (2023–25 reviews).
kyoto_shukura_pontocho.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 18:00–1:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 16:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advised for the 14 seats — 6 at the counter, 2 tables (Tabelog; August 2025). Seat charge ¥1,000 a person (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「1000円（お一人様あたり）」). Non-smoking, ashtray at the entrance (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and e-money (Tabelog). By the Pontocho Kaburenjo theatre at the Sanjo end; 3 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_shukura_pontocho.notes: [Sake bar · Pontocho, sixty sakes by the Kaburenjo] A small wooden sake bar at the Sanjo end of Pontocho with 60–70 sakes on hand, from Kyoto and Shiga breweries to summer and aged bottles. Tell the master or staff what you like and get a pour to match, or take a three-glass tasting set; snacks run from grilled heshiko and oden to a bowl of soba to finish. ¥1,000 seat charge. Open to 1:00, from 16:00 at weekends; a good second or last stop.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a master who explains and chooses sake (September 2024, February 2025, August 2026) and knowledgeable staff (February 2024); an August 2023 visitor heard the place had been open 11 years and that the owner also runs a nearby bar.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto and Shiga sake; tasting sets.

anecdotes.text: An August 2023 visitor had the Kyoto & Shiga set of three 80 ml pours for ¥2,000 and grilled heshiko for ¥800; the bill came to ¥6,900.
A seven-time regular finishes with the bar’s soba, a lighter end than ramen (August 2025).
An April 2025 diner felt the area has changed over the years and the bar now seems mostly frequented by visitors from abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: バー・日本酒バー・ダイニングバー、中京区木屋町三条下ル石屋町122-4、三条駅から徒歩約3分、月〜金 18:00〜翌1:00、土日祝 16:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:30)、不定休、予約可、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル8)、チャージ1人1,000円、禁煙 (入口に灰皿)、カード・電子マネー可、先斗町の Kaburenjo の近く、日本酒は常時60〜70種 (冷酒、燗酒、にごり、スパークリング、古酒)、京都・滋賀と全国の地酒。口コミ (2023年8月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都・滋賀の3種飲み比べ2,000円、へしこ焼き800円、おでん、酒蒸し、締めの蕎麦、マスターが好みに合わせて選ぶ、11年続く店という声 (2023年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Say what sake you like and let the staff choose; ¥1,000 seat charge; cards and IC cards.

kyoto_nijo_aritsune.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte Japanese dishes with soy and dashi, including crab cream croquettes, a beef cutlet sandwich and fried horse mackerel (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_aritsune.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, shellfish, chicken and beef dishes with dashi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nijo_aritsune.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00, last order 22:00); Sun 17:00–21:30 (last entry 20:00); closed Monday and two consecutive days a month (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; phone 12:00–16:00, as calls may go unanswered during service; ask even on days marked unavailable (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料・チャージ共に無し」). The menu shows no prices; reviewers spent about ¥15,000–20,000 a head (2026 reviews). 22 seats: a 10-seat counter, a table and private rooms for 4 and 6 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Near Nijo-Teramachi; 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; April 2026). Opened 18 August 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nijo_aritsune.notes: [Kappo-izakaya · Nijo Teramachi, build your own kaiseki] A grown-up izakaya near Nijo-Teramachi where you assemble your own course from a long, seasonal à la carte list — karasumi mochi and crab cream croquettes are the signatures, with charcoal-grilled fish, hairy crab and a beef cutlet sandwich you can take home. The menu has no prices; expect about ¥15,000–20,000, with no service charge. One March 2026 diner found the service slow. Closed Monday; book by phone 12:00–16:00.

roles: Head chef (unnamed); a new chef since the previous owner left (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the name means "to keep changing in order to remain the same"; an adult izakaya of carefully chosen ingredients and charcoal grilling, opened 18 August 2015. An August 2026 reviewer heard that the previous owner had left the year before to open a Kyoto restaurant in Milan, and wished the current chef well; reviewers describe the head chef as approachable (November 2025, September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "to keep changing in order to remain the same."
chef_bio.specialty: Karasumi mochi; crab cream croquette.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner found drinks and dishes so slow it was hard to order more.
A May 2026 diner liked the food but not the glass of white wine, and found the prices on the high side.
A July 2026 diner, already full, had the beef cutlet sandwich packed to eat on the Shinkansen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・居酒屋、中京区二条寺町西入丁子屋町694-3、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、火〜土 17:00〜23:00 (最終入店21:00、L.O. 22:00)、日 17:00〜21:30 (最終入店20:00)、月曜と月に2連休、電話は12:00〜16:00に、サービス料・チャージ共に無し、22席 (カウンター10席、個室)、禁煙、カード可、2015年8月18日オープン、店名には変わらないために変わり続けるという意味。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 品書きに値段がない、1人約15,000〜20,000円、からすみ餅と蟹クリームコロッケが名物、炭火の焼き魚、毛蟹、ビーフカツサンドの持ち帰り、先代は前年にミラノで京料理の店を開いたという声、提供が遅いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Order à la carte from a Japanese menu without prices; staff help; book by phone 12:00–16:00.

kyoto_nanzenji_sando_kikusui.gf_detail: Ask. Italian courses with handmade pasta and house bread (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_nanzenji_sando_kikusui.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable-rich Italian courses, but with seafood, meat and dairy, e.g. sea urchin pasta and chestnut tiramisu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nanzenji_sando_kikusui.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–16:00 (last food order 13:30), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last food order 20:00), open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; cancellation 20% three or two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (Tabelog). Private rooms for up to 6 and 16 at ¥11,000 a room (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「個室利用料：11,000円/室」). 26 seats in the dining room and two private rooms, overlooking the garden (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). Five parking spaces (Tabelog). On the approach to Nanzen-ji; 260 m from Keage Stn (Tabelog). Opened 11 June 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nanzenji_sando_kikusui.notes: [Italian · Nanzen-ji, a ryokan garden by Ogawa Jihei] A traditional inn on the approach to Nanzen-ji that serves Italian cooking to visitors as well as guests, in a dining room and private rooms looking onto a garden by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei. Courses of seasonal Kyoto produce with handmade pasta — an eight-dish lunch was ¥11,000 in 2025 — and a sommelier's list of 100-plus wines. Staff have taken guests’ photos in the garden. Private rooms ¥11,000 extra. Open daily.

roles: Hotel restaurant; chef unnamed (Tabelog: experience in Italian three-star restaurants)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a "cooking ryokan" — neither restaurant nor inn — serving Italian made with seasonal ingredients from around Kyoto, around a rare garden by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei. Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a ryokan by Nanzen-ji with authentic Italian by chefs with experience in Italian three-star restaurants, and wines chosen by a sommelier; opened 11 June 2018.
chef_bio.specialty: Italian courses; handmade pasta.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 diner celebrating Mother’s Day was photographed in the lit garden by the staff after dinner.
An October 2026 diner liked the recommended sea urchin pasta but might skip the pasta next time; the chestnut tiramisu was the best dish.
An April 2026 family, joined by an unexpected extra guest, were accommodated with à la carte dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoto-kikusui.com): 京都東山の和食・洋食を愉しむ料理旅館、七代目小川治兵衛の希少な庭、レストランでもない旅館でもない「料理旅館」、京都近郊のテロワールの旬の食材のイタリアン。食べログ: 旅館・イタリアン、左京区南禅寺福地町31、蹴上駅から260m、昼 12:00〜16:00 (料理 L.O. 13:30)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (料理 L.O. 20:00)、年中無休、予約可、キャンセル料 3日前・2日前20%、前日50%、当日100%、個室利用料11,000円/室、26席 (個室6名・16名)、カード・PayPay 可、駐車場5台、2018年6月11日オープン、手打ちパスタ、イタリアの三つ星で経験を積んだシェフ、ソムリエが選ぶ100種以上のワイン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 昼のイタリアン8品11,000円 (2025年11月)、庭を望む個室、雲丹のパスタ、栗のティラミス、アフタヌーンティー、子ども用プレート。

cultural_comfort.note: Book a course online; private garden-view rooms extra; cards and PayPay.

kyoto_kappou_taira.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kappo omakase with dashi soups, fu, sashimi with soy and ponzu; no gluten information (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_kappou_taira.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led kappo on a fish broth (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_kappou_taira.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Lunch omakase ¥6,600 (April 2023); a lunch course at ¥8,000 among several price levels (August 2026). 8 counter seats; private hire possible; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX and Diners (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya with a white noren and no sign, on Bukkoji-dori; about 6 min from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; June 2025).
kyoto_kappou_taira.notes: [Kappo · Bukkoji-dori near Shijo] An unsigned machiya with a white noren hides an eight-seat white-wood counter, where the chatty chef — once head chef at Gion's Senka, per a reviewer — cooks seasonal omakase and pours from a deep sake list. Lunch courses about ¥6,600–8,000; dinner around ¥10,000–15,000. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per 2023–26 reviews: an owner-chef who keeps up a lively conversation with each guest at the counter; an August 2026 reviewer writes the owner was formerly head chef at the Gion restaurant "Senka". A September 2025 reviewer notes staff serving the dishes.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kappo omakase; sake.

anecdotes.text: With "the lively chatter of Chef Taira", a November 2023 lunch guest felt completely at ease.
A February 2024 wine-pairing event surprised a guest who had doubted wine with Japanese food.
A September 2025 diner's son, training as a chef, quietly watched the cooking from the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 割烹たいら、日本料理、下京区仏光寺通柳馬場西入ル東前町401、四条駅から徒歩約6分、火〜日 12:00〜14:00・18:00〜23:00、月曜休み、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年8月、英語): 町家の白木のカウンター、看板のない白いのれん、昼のおまかせ6,600円、昼のコース8,000円、Chef Taira、祇園 Senka の元料理長、マグロのたたきと麩、甘鯛、ビワマス、ワカサギ、日本酒とワインのペアリングの会、魚の出汁。

kyoto_gion_daiki.gf_detail: Ask when booking. Kappo course with sushi, dashi, akadashi and fried dishes; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_daiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, crab, foie gras and wagyu courses (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_daiki.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday, but Sunday bookings for 6 or more by phone (Tabelog). Bookings by phone preferred; guests who cannot read Japanese must order the omakase course, not à la carte; cancellations two days ahead, the day before or on the day are charged 100%, and prepayments are not refunded (Tabelog). Service charge 10% — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料１０パーセント". 12 seats (counter with shoes off) plus private rooms for 2–18; smoking allowed at the counter seats; wheelchair accessible; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). At the end of a narrow alley by the Mame Roku Building, off Hanamikoji-Sueyoshi; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_daiki.notes: [Kappo & sushi · Gion off Hanamikoji] A hidden house at the end of a Gion alley, where an owner-chef who ran a Japanese restaurant in Bangkok for 15 years cooks Kyoto kappo alongside a father who is a sushi chef: Maizuru fish, foie gras chawanmushi, crab and kue hot pot in winter. Omakase ¥22,000 + 10%. Counter seats allow smoking. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Masayuki Tomimura (romaji, per an October 2024 review)
roles: Father: sushi chef with 50 years' experience (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator on Tabelog: born in 1975 in Kyoto Prefecture and drawn to cooking by watching a father who was a sushi chef; trained at Yoshitora in Kyoto, Kappo Kamitome in Kitashinchi and Kōmei ARIAKE in Tokyo, then ran the Japanese restaurant "Dai no Ki" in Bangkok as owner for 15 years; opened Gion Daiki in May 2018 (Tabelog: 28 May 2018) and runs it with the father, a sushi chef of 50 years. An October 2024 reviewer names the owner as Masayuki Tomimura, "Tomi". 2025–26 reviews mention a head chef, a hostess and staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: new ideas while keeping the flavours of Kyoto.
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras chawanmushi; sushi within the kappo course.

anecdotes.text: A family has made Gion Daiki its year-end tradition — snow crab and kue hot pot in December 2019.
A November 2024 guest noted a private room where smoking is allowed, with good ventilation.
A June 2026 diner celebrated a 60th birthday here and thanked "the owner and the hostess".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 祇園 大季、日本料理・寿司・鍋、東山区清本町374-4、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、Mame Roku Building から細い路地の奥、月〜土 17:00〜22:00、日曜休み (6名以上は電話で予約可)、日本語が読めない海外の客はおまかせコースのみ、2日前からのキャンセルは100%、サービス料１０パーセント、12席、個室2〜18名、カウンターは喫煙可、2018年5月28日オープン、1975年京都府生まれ、寿司職人の父、Yoshitora、Kappo Kamitome、Kōmei ARIAKE で修業、バンコクで Dai no Ki を15年経営、父と営む、Maizuru 港直送の魚、Shichijo Gozen の老舗の肉、寿司×割烹おまかせ22,000円 (+サービス料)。口コミ (2019年12月〜2026年10月、英語): フォアグラの茶碗蒸し、毛蟹、のどぐろ、クエ鍋、Masayuki Tomimura。

kyoto_k36.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar with bar food such as truffle fries and onion rings; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_k36.vegan_detail: Ask. Mainly drinks; the food menu is not described in the sources beyond fried snacks (2026 reviews).
kyoto_k36.hours_raw: The Bar (indoor) 15:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); Rooftop 15:00–24:00 (food last order 23:00, drinks 23:30) for 16 September–30 November 2026; open all year; the rooftop closes in bad weather (official site; Tabelog). Seat-only bookings are not taken — booking is by plan, with a ¥25,000-per-person minimum for reserved seats; walk-ins may wait (Tabelog; November 2026: about an hour). Service charge 10% plus a ¥1,100 charge per person — Tabelog's Japanese original: "サービス料10％に加え1,100円(税込)のチャージ料". Adults only in The Bar; the rooftop admits under-20s with an adult until 17:00, and from 17:00 no one of elementary-school age or younger, 13–19 only with an adult (official site). Smart casual in The Bar — no shorts, T-shirts or sandals (official site). 108 seats (rooftop 72, bar 36); wheelchair accessible; smoking space at the rooftop entrance; cards and IC cards (Tabelog). On the 4th floor of The Hotel Seiryu Kyoto Kiyomizu, the former Kiyomizu Elementary School; 5 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_k36.notes: [Rooftop bar · Kiyomizu, facing Yasaka Pagoda] The rooftop and bar of The Hotel Seiryu, a former elementary school, open to non-guests: cocktails with the Yasaka Pagoda lit up right in front of you and the city beyond. Come at sunset; expect to queue without a plan booking. ¥1,100 charge + 10% service; cocktails from about ¥1,650. Smart casual. Open daily to midnight.

roles: Butler (head of the bar), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: run by Stillfoods inc.; the bar invited 西田 稔, who runs the Kyoto bars Bar K6, Cave de K and Bar Keller, as its butler — a Champagne Officier, Krug ambassador, "knight of grappa" and whisky-contest judge. Opened 22 March 2020 (Tabelog). The main bar was converted from a classroom of the former Kiyomizu Elementary School (Tabelog; August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: K36 gin and tonic; sunset view.

anecdotes.text: A K6 regular in October 2026 followed Nishida-san here and calls K36 a pioneer among Kansai rooftop bars.
Without a booking, a November 2026 visitor waited about an hour to get in.
By 11 pm on a 15 °C October 2026 night, the rooftop was almost empty and the best tables free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (stillfoods.com/k36): K36 | The Bar & Rooftop、ザ・ホテル青龍 京都清水の宿泊者もビジターも利用できるルーフトップバー＆レストラン・メインバー、360度のパノラマビュー、法観寺・八坂の塔の眺望、The Bar 15:00〜24:00 (23:00 L.O.)、Rooftop 15:00〜24:00 (Food 23:00 L.O.、Drink 23:30 L.O.、2026年9月16日〜11月30日)、荒天時は Rooftop 閉鎖、The Bar は終日未成年不可、スマートカジュアル、バトラー 西田稔 (Bar K6、Cave de K、Bar Keller)、Stillfoods inc.。食べログ (店舗会員): ダイニングバー・バー、東山区清水2-204-2 4F、席のみの予約不可、席の予約は1人25,000円以上、サービス料10％に加え1,100円のチャージ料、108席 (ルーフトップ72、バー36)、2020年3月22日オープン。口コミ (2026年7〜11月、英語): K36 ジントニック1,650円、八坂の塔の夜景、旧清水小学校、予約なしで約1時間待ち。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel bar used to visitors; smart casual; ¥1,100 charge + 10% service.

kyoto_to_oike.gf_detail: Ask. Brioche crostini at breakfast; yatsuhashi, monaka, gyoza and fried dishes at night; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_to_oike.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: duck liver pâté, prosciutto, eggs, cheese, pork and fish dishes (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_to_oike.hours_raw: Breakfast 8:00–12:30 daily; dinner Mon, Wed, Thu, Sun 17:00–23:00 and Fri–Sat 17:00–24:00; no dinner on Tuesday, except Tuesday holidays (Tabelog). Bookings online, also for one person; breakfast starts together at the booked time with an explanation of the ingredients first, so dishes take about 30 minutes; walk-ins turned away when full (2026 reviews). 12 seats: an 8-seat single-plank counter around an island kitchen and two tables; Tabelog lists halal options; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). 3 min from Karasuma-Oike Stn exit 1 (Tabelog).
kyoto_to_oike.notes: [Creative izakaya & breakfast · Oike near Karasuma] The second shop of the popular Italian fudo: a 12-seat counter around an open kitchen serving playful small plates — duck pâté in yatsuhashi, Marsala pork belly — with natural wine at night, and booked-ahead crostini breakfasts from 8 am. Dinner about ¥4,000–6,000. Always busy: book.

chef_bio.background: Opened 14 January 2020 (Tabelog) as "the second store of Karasuma Oike's popular Italian Cuisine restaurant 'fudo'" (Tabelog); fudo is in our data as kyoto_fudo. Per the operator: a relaxed space like a friend's house, built around an island kitchen and a single-plank counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Hachi To. Bashi; crostini breakfast.

anecdotes.text: An 8 am September 2026 breakfast was full of overseas guests, many from Korea, and began with an explanation of the ingredients to everyone at once.
An October 2026 visitor found the slow, careful explanation lovely but noticed a later arrival being seated first.
A September 2026 fan of fudo came here for the same yatsuhashi starter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): To、居酒屋・創作料理、中京区御池高田町500 ポポラーレ御池 1F、烏丸御池駅1番出口から徒歩3分、月水木日 8:00〜12:30・17:00〜23:00、火 8:00〜12:30、金土 8:00〜12:30・17:00〜24:00 (祝日の火曜は営業)、12席 (一枚板のカウンター8、テーブル)、ハラール対応あり、2020年1月14日オープン、烏丸御池の人気イタリアン fudo の2号店、京都の鴨レバーのパテを焼き八ッ橋で挟んだ前菜、マルサラ酒の豚の角煮、鴨肉の餃子、果物の白和え、サルシッチャの麻婆豆腐、納豆ムースのご飯、自然派ワイン、小さな蔵の日本酒。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): ブリオッシュのクロスティーニの朝食、無花果と生ハム、半熟卵とハム、鱧のフライ、最中、要予約。

cultural_comfort.note: Book online (also for one); breakfast starts together at the booked time.

kyoto_mi_mitarashi_dango.gf_detail: Ask. The dango are glutinous rice (Leaf KYOTO), but the mitarashi glaze is a sweet soy sauce; Tabelog says allergy information is available.
kyoto_mi_mitarashi_dango.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain dango with bean paste, kinako or mitarashi glaze may suit, but there are ice-cream and latte options (2026 reviews); allergy information is available (Tabelog).
kyoto_mi_mitarashi_dango.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Mon 11:00–18:00; closed Tuesday. Bookings taken for the café. A dango counter at the entrance of the kolme kyoto glasses shop; order downstairs, then eat in a shoes-off room upstairs with two tables for four and two for two (May 2026), 10 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; wheelchair accessible; take-out; cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 3 March 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mi_mitarashi_dango.notes: [Dango · Yanagibamba-Sanjo, inside a glasses shop] A dango stand at the door of the kolme kyoto eyewear shop: order below, then slip off your shoes for a small room upstairs. Charcoal-grilled glutinous-rice dango in bright colours — the Hachifuku set brings eight flavours with matcha you whisk yourself — or a box of nine mitarashi to take away. One July 2026 diner found the flavours ordinary but the presentation charming. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Leaf KYOTO (2022): the glasses select shop kolme kyoto, reopened that spring, began selling dango with a Japanese confectioner as partner, hoping people would drop into a glasses shop more casually; the dango are charcoal-grilled glutinous rice. Opened 3 March 2022 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Leaf KYOTO: a reason for people to step into a glasses shop casually.
chef_bio.specialty: Mitarashi dango; eight-flavour dango set.

anecdotes.text: "I initially thought this was just a gimmicky shop for tourists, as it was located in front of a glasses store. However, my impression changed after trying the dango." — May 2026.
"The flavors were not particularly special, but they were generally tasty." — July 2026, on the eight-dango set.
A May 2026 diner was told to carry the take-away box flat because of all the sauce.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Leaf KYOTO (2022年5月): この春リニューアルした眼鏡のセレクトショップ kolme kyoto で団子の販売を始めた、和菓子店と組み、眼鏡店に気軽に入るきっかけに、炭火で焼くもち米の団子、みたらし9個のおもたせ団子700円、こしあん・つぶあん各800円、好きな団子2本と自分で点てる抹茶のセット1,000円、12:00〜17:00 (売り切れ次第終了)、不定休 (当時)。食べログ: カフェ・和菓子、中京区柳馬場三条下ル槌屋町89-1、水〜月 11:00〜18:00、火曜休み、予約可、10席、禁煙、アレルギー表示あり、子供・ベビーカー可、車椅子可、テイクアウト、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2022年3月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 入口で注文して2階の靴を脱ぐカフェへ、4人席2つと2人席2つ、八福セット (団子8種とドリンク)、自分で点てる抹茶、みたらし9個の持ち帰り1,000円ときな粉、翌日まで、みたらし抹茶アイス、ほうじ茶、味は普通という声、海外からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter by the door, then take shoes off upstairs; many overseas visitors (October 2026).

kyoto_el_rincon_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; paella, ajillo, charcoal-grilled meats and tapas, beside a pasta paella (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_el_rincon_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: jamón, octopus, anchovy, lamb, pork, beef and chicken paella (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_el_rincon_shijo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Monday and Tuesday. In 2021 lunch was served Friday to Sunday (June 2021 review, citing Instagram); Tabelog now lists dinner only. Bookings taken; even if online booking shows full, call — same-day and large groups by phone (Tabelog). 20 seats: two tables of 4, a counter of 4, private rooms for 2 and 4 and a semi-private room for up to 6, some in a half-basement (2025–2026 reviews); non-smoking; children welcome; English menu; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Opened 1 May 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_el_rincon_shijo.notes: [Spanish · Shijo-Karasuma, cave-like private rooms] A quiet Spanish restaurant a few minutes from Karasuma, with snug half-basement rooms. Fans praise the paella, octopus ajillo, charcoal-grilled meats and cava, and the warm, calm room. Recent visits were mixed: a September 2026 diner found the chef aloof and the staff chatting among themselves and left early; an October 2026 diner found the paella too salty. English menu. Dinner only, Wednesday to Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2018 (Tabelog). A June 2022 diner found it run by a single staff member that night; later reviews describe a chef and front-of-house staff, a counter, tables and half-basement private rooms.
chef_bio.specialty: Paella; octopus ajillo; charcoal-grilled meats.

anecdotes.text: "I was seated in a cozy pocket-like cave underground." — February 2025.
A July 2026 regular was put in a semi-basement private room and was grateful the restaurant let a booking move earlier at the last minute.
"The staff were chatting among themselves, and I wish they had done it somewhere out of earshot..." — September 2026.
"As for the paella, it was a bit too salty for my taste." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: El Rincon (エルリンコン)、スペイン料理、下京区神明町724、阪急烏丸駅19番出口から徒歩4分、水〜日 17:00〜23:00、月火休み、予約可 (ネットで満席でも電話で空きの場合あり)、20席 (4名テーブル2、カウンター4)、個室2名・4名、半個室6名まで、禁煙、子供可、英語メニュー、カード・PayPay 可、2018年5月1日オープン。口コミ (2021年5月〜2026年10月、英語): 2021年はランチあり (バルセロナランチコース1,800円、丹波鶏のパエリアランチ1,300円、金土日のみ)、パエリア、パスタのパエリア、蛸のアヒージョ、生ハム、ラム、豚、牛の炭火焼き、チーズ盛り合わせ、カルパッチョ、カヴァ、半地下の洞窟のような個室、2022年は一人で営業、2026年9月は料理人が無関心でスタッフの私語が気になった、2026年10月はパエリアが塩辛い。

kyoto_yamamoto_ryoriten.gf_detail: Ask. Skewers come with salt (Guérande sea salt) or a sweet tare (official site); the signature fried chicken has a dipping sauce of Hatcho miso, sesame paste and black vinegar, and the course ends with soba, ramen or oyakodon (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yamamoto_ryoriten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant — skewers, liver, fried chicken and chicken soup (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yamamoto_ryoriten.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–23:00; closed Sunday and two Mondays a month (Tabelog the same). Courses last 2 hours 30 minutes, with last drink orders 2 hours in (Tabelog). Same-day cancellation may be charged ¥7,000 per person (official site). Tabelog’s charge field reads 「500円」 (¥500), with no further detail. 8 counter seats (9 with an extra chair); non-smoking, with a smoking spot inside; school-age children; English menu; BYO allowed; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; official site). Opened 3 March 2026 (Tabelog); one October 2026 diner says April.
kyoto_yamamoto_ryoriten.notes: [Yakitori · Gojo, an eight-seat sommelier’s counter] Up the stairs of the Taisho-era Yuasa Kaikan, an eight-seat counter round a binchotan grill, opened in 2026 by an owner who spent over twenty years at a famous yakitori house and is a qualified sommelier. Big, crisp-skinned Omi Kurodori and Kyoto Akadori skewers, the signature twice-fried zaji chicken, and a chicken-broth soba to finish, with wines matched to salt or tare. Omakase with drinks ¥12,000. Booked up within months. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Yamamoto (surname from the shop name and 2026 reviews; no given name in a source)
roles: Owner-chef and sommelier (official site: ソムリエ資格を持つ店主)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a chicken restaurant run by an owner who honed the craft for over 20 years at a famous yakitori restaurant, on the belief that yakitori is proper cuisine; eight counter seats on the second floor of the Yuasa Kaikan; birds chosen cut by cut from Omi Kurodori, Kyoto Akadori and others; the owner tastes and selects every wine. Opened 3 March 2026 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a renovated Taisho-era building and say it became hard to book within six months.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: 「焼き鳥も立派な料理」 — yakitori is proper cooking too.
chef_bio.specialty: Large thigh skewers; 炸鶏 (zaji) fried chicken; chicken soba.

anecdotes.text: When some planned starters and skewers had sold out, the chef gave a September 2026 guest a discount.
An October 2026 diner who could only find a 9 pm slot on an all-you-can-drink course noticed walk-ins being seated later in the evening.
"I can't wait to come back to Kyoto just to see the owner again!" — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yamamotorestaurant.com): 山本料理店 (やまもとりょうりてん)、五条駅1番出口から徒歩4分、湯浅会館2階、有名焼き鳥店で20年以上腕を磨いた店主の鶏料理店、「焼き鳥も立派な料理」、近江黒鶏や京赤地どりを部位ごとに、もも串は約60g、皮を巻き込む串打ち、備長炭、ゲランドの塩と甘めのたれ、名物「炸鶏 (ザージー)」は京赤地どりの丸鶏をボイルして水飴を塗り半日干し、140度と170度で揚げ、八丁味噌・芝麻醤・黒酢のつけだれ、ソムリエ資格の店主が選ぶワイン25〜30種、おまかせコース (お飲み物付き) 12,000円 (税込)、カウンター8席、17:00〜23:00、日曜と月2回の月曜休み、当日キャンセルは1人7,000円の場合あり、カード・電子マネー可。食べログ: 焼き鳥・鶏料理・居酒屋、下京区五条通高倉上ル亀屋町172 湯浅会館2F、コースは2時間30分、料金欄に「500円」、8席 (補助席で9)、禁煙 (店内に喫煙所)、小学生以上、英語メニュー、持ち込み可、2026年3月3日オープン。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 大正時代の建物、近江黒鶏、ネクタイ (英語の口コミでは necktie)、白レバー、ハラミ、せせり、軟骨、つくね、むね肉のたたき、北京ダック風、フカヒレご飯、鶏そば、ラーメン、親子丼、半年で予約困難、売り切れの分を値引き。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog); book well ahead — later-evening walk-ins sometimes seated (October 2026).

kyoto_suehiro_teramachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; Kyoto pressed sushi with a sweet tare on the anago, simmered kanpyo and shiitake, and soy-seasoned fillings (official menu).
kyoto_suehiro_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Inari with carrot, burdock and sesame rice, and small kanpyo, cucumber, pickle and ume-shiso rolls are listed, but the fried tofu and kanpyo may be simmered in dashi; most sushi is mackerel, anago, sea bream or egg (official menu).
kyoto_suehiro_teramachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Wed–Sun 11:00–18:00, closing when sold out; dine-in until 15:00; closed Monday and Tuesday. No reservations to eat in; take-away can be ordered ahead by phone (2019 and March 2026 reviews). 6 seats at three small tables; queues of 30 minutes or more on winter weekends (March 2026). Non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR accepted (Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog. Prices rose on 2 April 2025 (official site).
kyoto_suehiro_teramachi.notes: [Kyoto sushi · Teramachi-Nijo, since the 1830s] A six-seat Kyoto sushi shop founded in the Tenpo era south of the Imperial Palace, still making mackerel sushi, box sushi, rolls and inari the old way — and, from November to March, warm steamed mushi-zushi topped with egg ribbons and grilled anago, which draws winter queues. Regulars rank its mackerel sushi above the famous names. One March 2026 diner waited 30 minutes and found it nothing special. Take-away by phone. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in the Tenpo era (1830–1844) as a cooked-food shop at Teramachi-Nijo, south of the Imperial Palace, keeping the taste of Kyoto sushi for about 200 years with unchanged methods — mackerel, box, rolled, inari and chirashi sushi, and steamed sushi in winter. Prices were raised from 2 April 2025 because of the rising price of rice (official site). An October 2026 diner found the owner and staff friendly.
chef_bio.philosophy: Official site: keeping to genuine Kyoto sushi.
chef_bio.specialty: Mackerel sushi; winter mushi-zushi; anago box sushi.

anecdotes.text: "Currently the Number One Saba Sushi in Kyoto" — October 2026, from a diner who had long bought elsewhere; the half roll of six came with a cooling pack.
